ja: 大いなるヒポグリフSharptalonは倒され、死んだ獣の鉤爪が勝利の証となった。  Silverwind RefugeにいるSenani Thunderheartは、勝利の証拠としてこの戦利品を見たがることだろう。
en: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory.  Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
en_objectives: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
label: misaligned
note: place differs: Silverwind Refuge vs Splintertree Post (Cataclysm rename)

ja: Gnollという粗野な生き物をElwynn Forestの境界に沿って見ることができます。我々だけで相対するには多すぎる一団が、南のガードタワー近辺にはびこっています。他にもStone Cairn Lakeの近くにいます。  Stomewind Armyは彼らを殺す何者でも歓迎します。彼らのPainted Gnoll Armbandをあなたの功績の証として、持ってきてください。
en: Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.$B$BThe Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
en_objectives: Bring 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands to Deputy Rainer at the Barracks.
label: aligned

ja: {name}、密偵からの報告によると Kobold の群れの横行が我々の予想以上のようです。Kobold worker の群れがここから北の Echo Ridge Mine に巣食っています。
en: $N, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought.  A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.$B$BGo to the mine and remove them.  We know there are at least 10.  Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.
en_objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Workers, then report back to Marshal McBride.
label: aligned

ja: 最近、Defias Brotherhoodという新手の盗賊一団が、Northshireの東の川沿い辺りをうろついているらしいのだ。
en: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.$B$BI don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
en_objectives: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
label: aligned

ja: 巨大な熊Ursangousはもういない!  前足にある上弦の月のかたちをした紋章は、敵を探して森をうろつくナイトエルフたちによって訓練されたことを示している。この獣にどれほど多くの仲間たちが殺されたか分からない。  この前足はSilverwind RefugeのTarkanのところへ持っていくべきだろう。敵の武器庫からこういった「武器」が取り除かれたのを彼は喜ぶことだろう。
en: The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.  On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery.$B$BThe paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.
en_objectives: Bring Ursangous's Paw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
label: misaligned
note: Cataclysm version: Tarkan at Silverwind Refuge vs Senani Thunderheart

ja: 俊敏だったShadumbraも、今やあなたの勝利を示すかのように横たわっている。  伝説のこの獣はナイトエルフにとって大切な存在だった。この首は敵を竦み上がらせる戦利品として、そしてAshenvaleにおけるalliance終焉の象徴として役割を果たすことだろう。  Hellscream's Watchの隊長Goggathならば、殺されたナイトセイバーの首を喜んで受け取るに違いない。
en: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it.  The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt.  Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
en_objectives: Bring Shadumbra's Head to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
label: misaligned
note: Cataclysm version: Hellscream's Watch/Goggath vs Splintertree Post

ja: {class}、お前にも見せてやりたかったな!  エルフどもはSilverwindを攻め落とせないと思ったんだ。厚い防御と水のエレメンタルの軍勢があったからな、それはほぼ正しかった。  ほぼ、な。  俺たちのメイジで、他のエレメンタルを怒りで我を忘れさせるようにするエレメンタルを召喚できる奴がいたのさ。  あー、奴らの顔ときたら!  <Tarkanは笑った。>  残念ながら、そのエレメンタルを召喚できるメイジは戦闘中に死んでしまってな。今はエレメンタルを片付ける奴が必要なんだ。
en: If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?$B$BThe transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.$B$BYou up for being useful?
en_objectives: Dispatch 12 Befouled Water Elementals at Mystral Lake, due east of the Talondeep Path and southwest of Splintertree Post.$B$BScout the gazebo on Mystral Lake that overlooks the nearby Alliance outpost.$B$BReturn to Mastok Wrilehiss at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (Talondeep Path transports vs Silverwind siege)

ja: Morbent Felは住処に隠れている。Raven Hill墓地を見渡せる東の丘の上にある家だ。奴の命もあとわずかだ……。
en: Morbent Fel hides in his lair, the house perched atop the hill to the east overlooking the Raven Hill cemetery.  His time in this land is drawing to an end...$B$BUse Morbent's Bane against him.  It will render his protective magics powerless.$B$BSlay him.  Slay him, and save us from his wickedness.  Be the instrument of my revenge, and a hero of Duskwood!
en_objectives: Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
label: aligned

ja: Northshireの鉱山は問題だらけだ！Elwynn地方のFargodeep Mineも例外ではなく、コボルドの巣窟と化しているという報告を受けている。  Fargodeep Mineを調査し、この報告の裏づけをとってきてほしいのだ。問題の鉱山はGoldshireの南に位置し、StonefieldとMaclure homesteadsの間にある。
en: The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.$B$BExplore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
en_objectives: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
label: aligned

ja: Silverpineの海岸沿い、Sepulcherの西に、病に冒されつつある聖地があります。そこの精霊はもう語りかけてくることはありません。泉を浄化し、具現化した精霊を倒すのはお任せします。
en: Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.$B$BTake the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.$B$BBring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.
en_objectives: Defeat the Corrupt Manifestation of Water and place the Corrupted Manifestation's Bracers along with the Remaining Drops of Purest Water on the Brazier of Everfount in Silverpine Forest.
label: aligned

ja: ２つのメダルを手に入れた今、Guard Thomasにすぐに持っていく必要がある。彼らは殺されたということを伝えなければならない。
en: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
en_objectives: Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.
label: aligned

ja: 樽の中に、Dran用の梱包したrippleだけじゃなく、彼が盗んだ別のボトルにも特別な保護を施しておいた。Dranを高く評価しているとは言えないかもしれないけれど、乱暴に扱われたrippleほど悪い物はないからさ。お礼は結構だよ。
en: I have taken the extra step of securing not only Dran's packaged ripple in the barrel, but also the extra bottles of ripple he is purloining.  While I may not hold Dran very highly, there is nothing worse than jostled ripple.  You're welcome.$B$BNow, deliver yon barrel to Dran Droffers in his salvage emporium in Orgrimmar.  Pray tell, please extend my warmest greetings to Malton; let him know that should he ever thirst for fine drink and finer drinking companions, we would be honored with his visit.
en_objectives: Deliver the barrel to Dran Droffers in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: Elwynnにいる悪党は、上質な麻製品を作るのに必要な麻を着てるの。  私に麻の端切れを持ってきてくれたら、それを使って何か作ってあげる。  犯罪者たちはElwynn Forest中にいるわよ。
en: The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.$B$BBring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.$B$BDefias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.
en_objectives: Bring 6 Red Linen Bandanas to Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp.
label: aligned

ja: ちょっとした秘密を教えてあげるよ。黒っぽい「カニ肉」ハンバーグ(Dusky 'Crab' Cakes)は蜘蛛の脚の肉でできてるんだ! ちょっと気持ち悪いけど、ピリ辛のいい味で素晴らしいおやつになるんだな、これが! 蜘蛛のねばねばした脚(Gooey Spider Legs)を持ってきてくれたら、急いで作ってあげるよ。
en: I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.$B$BI hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
en_objectives: Gather 6 Gooey Spider Legs and bring them to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
label: aligned

ja: 謎の穢れがこの森を這い回っていますから、自己防衛は必ず必要ですよ。風が語りかけてくるのです。近い将来、大きな危険があなたを待っていると。
en: As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.$b$bIf you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
en_objectives: Bring 10 Ghoul Fangs, 10 Skeleton Fingers and 5 Vials of Spider Venom to Madame Eva in Darkshire.
label: aligned

ja: 終えるべき仕事があとひとつ残ってる。Edwin VanCleefを暗殺しなくてはならない。どんな奴であれ死刑宣告をするのは悲しいことだが、VanCleefをきっちり葬ることはWestfallの人々の大義のためだ。それを成し遂げたら、悪党の首を持ってきてくれ。
en: There is but one task left for you to complete.  Edwin VanCleef must be assassinated.  While it saddens me to condemn any man to a death sentence, it is for the greater good of the people of Westfall that VanCleef is laid to rest once and for all.  Bring me the villain's head once the deed is done.
en_objectives: Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
label: aligned

ja: 鉱山のトンネルが落盤したあの恐ろしい日に、友人はほとんど死んでしまった。もしMoonbrookの鉱山へ行くことがあったら、どうか友人たちの身元を確認できるようなものを探してほしい。Miners' Union Cardを見つけたら、私のところへ持ってきてくれ。友人の家族があの恐ろしい出来事から何かを解明できるようにするつもりだ。
en: Many of my friends perished that horrible day when the mine tunnel caved in.  If your adventures happen to bring you into that wing of the mine in Moonbrook, please keep an eye out for any sign which might identify them.  If you come across any of their Miners' Union Cards, bring them back to me and I'll make sure their families get some resolution from this horrible accident.
en_objectives: Retrieve 4 Miners' Union Cards and return them to Wilder Thistlenettle in Stormwind.
label: aligned

ja: とても親切にしてくれたね、{name}。子供週間をこんなに楽しく過ごせるなんて、夢にも思ってなかった。どうもありがとう。  他の孤児のみんなも、僕らがしたのと同じことをしてるといいな。また Craggle Wobbletop を見つけて模造刀の掛台を買ってくれる? あの人はまだ Trade District の外の水路で荷車を押してると思うよ。そうすれば、孤児院のみんなも遊べるでしょ!  その後は、家に帰る時間だね。
en: You have been so very kind to me, $N.  I never dreamed that I'd have so much fun during Children's Week.  Thank you.  I don't wanna be sad about what's happened to me and all - my folks always told me to rise above anything bad that happens.  You know, when I grow up I wanna be a hero... just like you.$B$BI'm sad to say this, but it's time for me to go home.  Let's go back and I'll tell the matron what an awesome person you are!
en_objectives: Return your ward to the Stormwind orphanage by handing in the Human Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Nightingale in the Cathedral District.
label: aligned

ja: トロルどもが暴れてるんだ。いつもよりひどいな。前、奴らが戦闘集団を作ってるのを見たんだが、今回は……それとは違う。  一番大事なものはAnvilmarの防御だ。Anvilmarの注意がトログへ向いている間にトロルに横から攻撃させたりなどせんぞ。トロル部隊の人数をちょっとばかし減らしに行ってくれ。俺たちがまだ警戒を解いていないと思い知らせてやらにゃな。
en: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.$b$bFrom what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.$b$bPerhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
en_objectives: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (Anvilmar troll defence vs Senir/Dun Morogh)

ja: Elder Stranglethorn tiger は群れで一番強い虎だ。何人もの {race} {class} がその鋭い歯と頑丈な鉤爪で己の死を目の当たりにした。  Elder Stranglethorn tiger を倒したと知れば Ajeck は感激するだろう。彼らの最大の群れは南の Sundering 付近、Cape of Stranglethorn の境界で見つかる。
en: Now I'm going to up the stakes on you and truly test your skill.  Prove to me you can kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.  If you can do that, you will be ready for your final challenge before I declare you a master tiger hunter in Master Nesingwary's presence.$b$bElder Stranglethorn Tigers are not only the most difficult to find, they are also the fiercest to defeat.
en_objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.
label: misaligned
note: mentions Cape of Stranglethorn (Cataclysm zone) and Ajeck; Vanilla text is a kill-10 test

ja: 滅多に人目に触れることのない雌の虎の伝説がある……とても力強く、年を経た雄でさえ小さく見えるという。Nesingwary's Expedition のハンターが追っているが、失敗に終わっている。大勢のハンターがその神速の鉤爪の餌食となり、死体は Grom'gol 北にある彼女の棲む丘の麓で朽ちている。  人はその虎を Sin'Dall と呼ぶ。  未だ {race} で誰一人為し遂げたことのない偉業―― Sin'Dall を狩り、殺し、その前足を手にする――を達成することを決意した。
en: Here is the final challenge that I will put forth.  We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks.  We call the beast Sin'Dall.  See if you can do what no $r has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall.  Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.$b$bTracking her down will be no easy task.
en_objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
label: aligned

ja: Hemet Jr. 率いるハンター集団の狩りに加わりたいんだったら、優秀なパンサーハンターだってことを示してもらわないとな。簡単なところから始めるといい。ひとまず若い豹に集中すればいい。腕を上げてハンターとして経験を積むにつれ、だんだんと危険な獲物を見つけることだろう。  東に向かうところから始めてくれ。熟練のパンサーハンターになったら戻ってこい。
en: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group Hemet has assembled, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter.  We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry.  Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.$b$bTracking them down is only half the challenge...
en_objectives: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.
label: aligned

ja: より困難な試練に向かうべきだ。ジャングルに分け入り、lashtail raptor 10頭を仕留めれば充分であろう。lashtail raptor ならばこれまでに始末したラプターより強いことは間違いない。  lashtail raptor は主に南東の Kal'ai Ruins 周辺にいる。
en: Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it.  Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors.  Let's see what you've got!
en_objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Lashtail Raptors.
label: aligned

ja: {name} 、君はこの集団に相応しいハンターだ。君が見せたような武器の腕前は Lordaeron の戦場からこの深いジャングルに至るまで、ほとんどお目にかからなかったよ。  凶暴な Sin'Dall 、狡猾な Bhag'thera 、危険な Tethis を君は殺してきたが、最高の獲物は王 Bangalash の首だよ。あの白い虎のためにここにいるんだ……奴は依然として南のねぐらから私を嘲っている。Bangalash を殺せば、君の狩りの腕に並ぶ者なしと証明される。
en: $N, you are a hunter worthy of our company.  From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.$b$bYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis.  But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash.  That white tiger is the reason I am here.  I've had my sights on him for quite some time now.  Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
en_objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
label: aligned

ja: お前さんを偵察に寄越すとは、Sorenの奴、やるな。そこでお前さんが聞いたのは良い情報だ。  問題は仕事が増えたということだな。今混乱しているトロルどもが、Coldridgeからドワーフをいまだに追い出したがっているんだ。それと俺はこの雪渓を火の悪魔に湖に変えさせるつもりもない。  トロルの指導者とその手下と火のエレメンタル、全部南東の洞窟の中にいるはずだ。奴らを全部殺してくれ。
en: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.$b$bYou've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
en_objectives: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (troll leader cave vs stolen journal)

ja: Svenと俺は、東にいるネクロマンサーやら何やらで危険な日々を送ってるんだ。ここで二人っきりだから、自分たちの食糧は自分で調達しなきゃならない。肉をキャンプへ持ち帰ろうと戻る時、いつも凶暴な狼どもが餌を求めてやって来るんだ。言うまでもなく、ここでの生活は危険だよ!
en: Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!$B$BBut if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
en_objectives: Kill 12 Starving Dire Wolves and 8 Rabid Dire Wolves, then return to Lars at Sven's Camp on the western border of Duskwood.
label: aligned

ja: まあ、君が私に手を貸してくれないなんて、私は思ってもいないんだがな、YOUR_GENDER(坊や;娘)よ。今日この手紙の束が山道を通ってやってきたんだが、私はこれを届ける時間がさっぱり無いんだ。
en: Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, $g lad : lass;? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.$b$bThey're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.$b$bWhat do you say?
en_objectives: Deliver the stack of letters to Talin Keeneye.
label: aligned

ja: 私の記憶が確かなら、Grelinは南東に道を下ったところで、野営しているはずだ。彼はしきりに鎧を欲しがってたな。
en: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
en_objectives: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
label: aligned

ja: この死体処理師というのは、子供のおとぎ話の中にある名前です。彼は優しい錬金術師で、妻Elizaの死で気が触れてしまったのです。妻を生き返らせようとして、彼は暗黒魔法を使って伴侶の胸の中に自分の心臓を入れました。
en: The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories.  He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza.  To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.$B$BThis revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.$B$BHis heart is his power.  Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats.  Do this and his power will be broken.
en_objectives: Find Eliza's grave.  Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
label: aligned

ja: 私の報告書の裏付けの為、助けを借りたいんだ、, {name}. 私はトロルが潜む場所をようやく見つけたんだが、トロルの数が多すぎて、中に入るのがためらわれる。  私が必要としているのは・・洞窟に入り、中を探索し、トロルを何匹か殺してから、ここへ戻って来る事だ。  Kharanosを出たら北へ向かえ、橋についたら、凍った川を西へ、Iceflow Lakeに着くだろう。Brewnall Villageが西の岸に見えたら、砦は村の南西にある。
en: I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $n. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.$b$bHere's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.$b$bTake the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
en_objectives: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
label: aligned

ja: 地殻変動によってトログは集団で地表に追いやられ、Frostmane族トロルは命からがら逃げなければならなくなった。残念なことに、奴らはすぐ近くに住み着いて俺たちの邪魔をすることにしたようだ。  町の南西にあるGrizzled Denのウェンディゴを監視するべく、Mountaineer Dunstanと分隊をあそこに配備したんだが、すぐKharanosに呼び戻さなきゃいかんのだ。あいつらを探して、ノームがくれた遠隔監視ロボットを配置してKharanosへ戻ってくるように伝えてくれ。
en: Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?$B$BWell...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
en_objectives: Gather 8 Wendigo Manes and bring them to Pilot Stonegear.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (Grizzled Den wendigo watch vs siege engine)

ja: Garren's Hauntの南西にある大きな墓は、あの災いがはじめてTirisfalの地に訪れたとき命を落とした・・非常に多くの人を埋葬するために作られた。
en: The Mass Graves, southwest of Garren's Haunt to the north, were made to accommodate the...impressive...number of deaths Tirisfal suffered when the Plague first came.  $B$BThe bodies in these graves have so far been spared an undeath, but the Scourge now send Rot Hide Gnolls to gather the corpses and use them to bolster their armies.  This cannot be allowed!$B$BYour task is twofold: slay the Rot Hides at the Mass Grave and Garren's Haunt, and gather from them the Embalming Ichor that gives them life.
en_objectives: Kill Rot Hide Graverobbers and Rot Hide Mongrels.  $B$BBring 8 Embalming Ichors to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
label: aligned

ja: Executor Zygandから聞いたが、Scarlet Crusaderどもを殺しまくってたんだってな。
en: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.$b$bVarimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.$b$bVenture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
en_objectives: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
label: aligned

ja: Duskwoodの住人をおろそかにすることだけでも充分ひどいというのに、Ebonlocke卿の判決により悪党Dextren Wardを打ち首にするより、Stormwindで収監するという決定を下して、House of NoblesはDarkshire Councilを軽蔑しておるのだ。
en: As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.$b$bWard was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.$b$bAssassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
en_objectives: Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.
label: aligned

ja: これはBrillにいる私の上官Executor Zygandに持っていく必要があるな。これで緋色十字軍の奴らに決定打を与えてやることができるな。ここDeathknellでお前はよくやってくれている。しかしZygandに誰かがこれを届けねばならん。それにかれはお前にもっとふさわしい任務を与えてくれるだろう。
en: These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in Brill. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the Scarlet Crusade. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.$b$bTake the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
en_objectives: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.
label: aligned

ja: わしは本来ならGnomereganへ戻って、被爆したノームの治療法研究を続けねばならんのだ。  だが、Kharanosはわしの故郷だし、Frostmane族の襲撃から防衛するのを助けたいからこの町に残っておる。蒸気戦車のメンテと修理をして働いとるんだ。  どういうわけかFrostmane scavengerは修理を終えるのに要るジャイロメカニックギアを気に入っててのう。あやつらは町の南東のFrostmane Front全体におる。ギアを取り戻すのを手伝ってくれんかね?
en: Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.$b$bOzzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
en_objectives: Bring Razzle Sprysprocket in Kharanos 8 Restabilization Cogs and 8 Gyromechanic Gears.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (gyromechanic gears vs Gnomeregan analysis)

ja: トンネルにいるtrogg族は非常に敵対的だ。トンネルを通る旅人に何のためらいもなく襲い掛かる。君は頑健そうだが、それでも安全とはいえん。
en: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.$b$bDirections? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.$b$bMake your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
en_objectives: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
label: aligned

ja: Quinn Yorickを回復させる薬がこれだ。
en: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.$B$BNow if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
en_objectives: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
label: aligned

ja: 元老院' (the Senate) と Explorers' League の一員として、わしは石切場の実地調査を引き受けた。トログがはびこっておるわい!Gol'Bolar quarry はトログにやられてめちゃめちゃだ。地中深くへ掘り進めたらトログがあふれ出て、設備を壊して地下の鉱夫を捕まえたのだ。鉱夫を救出せねばならん。メイジに残業させて、帰還のルーンを作らせた。捕まった鉱夫にこれを渡してくれれば、皆安全に地上へ戻れる。
en: As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.$b$bThey've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.$b$bIf you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
en_objectives: Kill 10 Rockjaw Bonesnappers for Senator Mehr Stonehallow at the Gol'Bolar quarry.
label: aligned

ja: とうとう、我々はGol'dirの行方を調べ始めた。彼の周囲で人間たちが動いているが、我々は北の大きなキャンプが怪しいと睨んでいる。
en: At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large Syndicate camp just north of here.$b$bGo there, $n, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
en_objectives: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.
label: aligned

ja: Stranglethorn へようこそ!  お前さんは気付いてないだろうが、そこにいるドワーフは、Alliance の高名な英雄であり熟練の大物ハンターである Hemet Nesingwary 様の一人息子なのだ。父君のように、彼もキャンプによそ者が来ることを好まない方だが、お前さんはちったぁ実戦の経験があるようだな、{class} 。  彼と話しに行け。父君にそっくりだから、お前さんに猟犬の仕事を回してくれることもあるかもしれんぞ。
en: Welcome to Stranglethorn!$b$bPerhaps you're not aware of this, but that dwarf over there is the one and only Hemet Nesingwary, renowned war hero of the Alliance and master big game hunter.  He's not one for welcoming strangers into his camp, but you look like you've seen quite a bit of action in your day, $c.$b$bBeing a veteran of many battles himself, Master Nesingwary has a soft spot for fellow heroes.$b$bGo and speak with him.  Perhaps he can give you some hunting pointers.
en_objectives: Speak with Hemet Nesingwary.
label: aligned

ja: 伝説によれば、１つの宝石がStranglehornの中心部深くに隠されています。私たちは大きな力をもつそれをMind's Eyeと呼んでいます。もし、あなたがそのEyeを手に入れたなら、私たちはYennikuを暗闇から連れ戻せるかもしれません。
en: Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn.  We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers.  If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.$B$BI will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye.  While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks.  The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.
en_objectives: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
label: aligned

ja: 私はMind's EyeをSoul Gemへと作り変えました。その目的は２つです。まずYennikuを気絶させなければなりません。それから、彼の魂を捕らえるために頭の上にそれを置かなければなりません。
en: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem.  Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.$B$BThen, bring the gem to Nimboya.$B$BYenniku dwells with Zanzil the Outcast, at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the distant Cape of Stranglethorn.
en_objectives: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to Nimboya.
label: aligned

ja: 仕事が欲しそうだね、相棒。なぜ陸を愛する{race}{class}がBlackwater Raidersを助けようとするのかわからないけど、断りはしないよ。
en: You sure seem eager to work, matey.  Not sure why some land-loving $r $c is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.$b$bOur ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.$b$bAll the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies!  What I need is a scout.$b$bCheck the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.
en_objectives: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.
label: aligned

ja: Thoras Trollbaneが死にStromgardeが廃墟となると、Vol'jinは人間たちの手にある伝説剣Trol'kalarに我々の全力を向けるように指示しました。来たるZu'Gurubトロルとの戦いのために。
en: With Thoras Trollbane dead and Stromgarde in ruins, Vol'jin has instructed that we make every effort to spirit the legendary sword Trol'kalar from the humans' hands, so that we might use it in our coming battles against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.$b$bZengu, one of our seasoned hunters, was dispatched to Hammerfall in northeastern Arathi Highlands to oversee its procurement.
en_objectives: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.
label: aligned

ja: 君に話してきてもらいたいのは、Gilveradin Sunchaserというハイエルフだ。どんなワインでも年代物でもすっかり全部、匂いだけで名前を言い当てられるんだ! 彼なら俺たちが必要としてる梱包ができるから、彼と話をしてほしい。必要なのは梱包用の6本と、2本はパパに、それと彼は一体何本欲しがるかな……本当だよ、彼は何本か欲しがると思う。rippleを梱包してパパのボトル2本を手に入れたら、ここへ戻ってきてくれ!
en: The elf you will need to talk to is Gilveradin Sunchaser.  He can name any wine, vintage and all, just by smell alone!  He can package up the ripple we need, so you'll need to talk with him.  We need six bottles for packaging, two for dad, and how ever many he'll want... and believe me, he'll want some.  When you've packaged the ripple and got dad's two bottles, come back here!$B$BGilveradin's camp is near some high elf lodge in the Hinterlands, and those high elves are not good.  Trust me.
en_objectives: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
label: aligned

ja: <Hammertoeは傷を抑え、再び話し出すまでに落ち着きを取り戻すのにしばらくかかった。>
en: <Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.>$B$BFind Ryedol, $N. Bring 'im me amulet. <cough cough> He'll... <cough> figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he... <cough>... knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. They must not be allowed to find the scrolls... <cough>
en_objectives: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands.
label: aligned

ja: 試掘者Agmondは南西のBadlandsにある発掘現場を任せられていたんだ。「任せられていた」と言ったのは……うむ、ここ何週間か彼からの連絡が無くてな。彼の報告を受けられるようAgmondを探してもらいたいんだ。
en: Prospector Agmond was in charge of our excavation sites in the Badlands, to the southwest.  I say "was" because...well, I haven't heard from him in weeks.  I need you to find Agmond so I can get his report.$B$BLast I heard Agmond was at the southernmost dig site in the Badlands--a tiny operation past the Angor Fortress.  I'd start your search for him there.
en_objectives: Find Agmond.
label: aligned

ja: swoop はずる賢い鳥で、見つけて狩るのは難しい。Swoop の羽の収集は、狩人にとって決断力と賢さの印なのだ。  もしこの仕事にとりかかりたいのなら、平原に行き、swoop を狩るんだ。  羽を持ってきて、君の一族に名誉をもたらすのだ。  swoop は Mulgore のあちこちで見つけられるだろうが、奴らを見つけるには目を鋭く光らせろ。そして、捕まえるには俊足でなくてはならん。
en: The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.$B$BIf you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.$B$BBring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.$B$BThe swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
en_objectives: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
label: aligned

ja: Ghost Howlのぼろぼろの皮は、Burning Legionとの戦いで受けたひどい傷をとどめている。  Camp Sungrazeの誰かが、Ghost Howlの死について知っているかもしれない……
en: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.$B$BPerhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
en_objectives: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
label: misaligned
note: place differs: Camp Sungraze vs Bloodhoof Village

ja: stormstout、いい酒だったろ?
en: Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?$B$BI have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.$B$BBring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.$B$BLike I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.
en_objectives: Bring 5 Lightning Glands, 1 Thunderhawk Saliva Gland and 1 Kodo Liver to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.
label: aligned

ja: plainstriderのこと知ってる? 役立たずな動物。飛べないし、臭いし、脳みそなんか私の拳ほどしかないし。頭が鈍くて移動中の荷車を通せんぼするし。あの石頭のおかげで荷車の車軸をずいぶん壊したもんよ……。時々、quillboarが襲撃の前にわざとplainstriderの群れを追い立ててキャラバンの行く手を塞いでいるんじゃないかって思うわ。  {class}、頑張って。汚らしいあの鳥をたくさん狩って道から一掃して。証拠にくちばしを持ってきてちょうだい。
en: Your first prey will be easy.$B$BThe plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.$B$BPut down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
en_objectives: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
label: aligned
note: Cataclysm rewrite of the same plainstrider quest; same objective

ja: Barrensのオアシスには謎が隠されている。水に生命エネルギーが流れていて、それを飲んだ動物や吸い上げた植物を生き生きとさせているのだ。  活力に満ちあふれ、そして変容する。  北西の忘れられし泉(the Forgotten Pools)のそばにキノコが生えている。その胞子に有益な効能があることを、我々Lordaeronの薬師が発見したのだ。  胞子を持ってきてくれたら、感謝する。
en: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.$B$BInvigorating, and altering.$B$BThere is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.$B$BBring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
en_objectives: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
label: aligned

ja: ケンタウロスどもは長年トーレンを悩ませてきた。最近じゃ、BarrensのKolkar族ケンタウロスは真の脅威となるほど増大した。本来なら各地のケンタウロスはまとまりのある奴らではないんだが、新しい指導者が現れてな。まとめあげたんだ。  我々の領地を保つには、ケンタウロスの指導者たちを殺さなくてはならん。  Barak Kodobaneの首を持ってきてくれ。奴の野営は忘れられた泉(the Forgotten Pools)の西にある。  奴を倒したら、戻ってくるんだぞ。
en: The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years.  And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat.  Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them.  Rallying them.$B$BTo preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.$B$BBring me the head of Barak Kodobane.  He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.$B$BDefeat him, then return to me.
en_objectives: Bring Barak's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
label: aligned

ja: ケンタウロスの指導者は、互いに足並みを揃えるために、統率のとれた信頼のおける中心的戦士を頼りにしているのだ。そいつらを減らせば、Kolkar族の猛烈な攻撃を支える柱は無くなる。そこで、お前さんに頼みたい賞金稼ぎがある。  南のLushwater Oasis周辺でKolkar MarauderとKolkar Stormseerを殺して、腕輪を集めてくれ。戦利品を山のように集めて戻ってきたら、Hordeは報酬を弾むぞ。
en: The Kolkar are a threat to the Horde's claims in the Barrens; we must reduce the numbers of their troops.  And so, I have a bounty task for you.$B$BWhile in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers.  Return when you have a heap of bracers and the Horde will reward you well.
en_objectives: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
label: aligned

ja: 行けば分かると思う……状況は最悪さ。ここにボタンが数個、それとレバーなどなど……さて、準備はいいかい?
en: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
en_objectives: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
label: aligned

ja: 動物の足跡が残骸を取り巻いている。巨大な鉤爪でつけられており、どうやらラプターの足跡のようだ。  ラプター乗りがキャラバンを襲撃したというのが第一印象だったが、足跡は深くなく、動物以外の足跡も見られなかった。  足跡は北東を向いて、Thorn Hillの東側へと続いている。その影に謎の答えがあるに違いない。
en: Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.$B$BThe strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!$B$BI don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!$B$BHunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
en_objectives: Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.
label: aligned
note: same quest (stolen silver / raptor tracks), different paragraph

ja: Ratchetの海賊問題を解消できたら昇進だってGazloweが約束してくれたんだ。その問題ってのは、南のFray Islandにやって来て島を占拠した別の海賊のことさ。奴らは積荷を狙ってるだけじゃない……恨みを晴らしに来たんだ! この間の夜、奴らはオレたちのガリオン船まで追いかけたんだ。  問題を解決する計画を思いついたんだけど、Gazloweは目に見える成果を求めてる。Fray Islandへ向かって、ちょいと首を切り取ってきてくれないか?
en: I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!$b$bI heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
en_objectives: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and 6 Southsea Cannoneers for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (Gazlowe/Fray Island vs Vice Admiral Grezzlik)

ja: Theramoreから来たいかれた人間どもに船団の船がまたやられた!  新しくやって来た海軍少将がこの海岸のすぐそばに駐留している。停船に従わない船は、奴の気紛れで臨検されたり沈められたりしているのだ。  商人海岸(the Merchant Coast)に沿って南下し、奴のキャンプへ向かってくれ。海兵と甲板員のメダルを持ってきてほしい。そして奴らのボス、副官PyreとBucklandを抹殺しろ。奴らが俺の船団をめちゃくちゃにしたように、奴らをめちゃくちゃにしてくれ!
en: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!$b$bThose bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.$b$bTravel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
en_objectives: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun of Ratchet wants you to collect 10 Theramore Medals and slay Captain Fairmount, Cannoneer Whessan and Cannoneer Smythe.
label: misaligned
note: place differs: Theramore/Merchant Coast vs Northwatch Hold

ja: お尋ね者!  Maiden's Dagger号キャプテンJ. Garvey  公海上における海賊行為・誘拐・強奪・放火・奴隷使役その他の罪により起訴されている。Garveyは最近Southsea Freebooters乗組員を率いてこの水域に現れ、Fray Islandを襲撃しているのを目撃された。本人確認可能な状態の証拠を持ってくること!  Gazlowe
en: WANTED!$b$bBaron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless$b$bCaptain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!$b$b-- Gazlowe
en_objectives: Bring the head of Baron Longshore to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
label: misaligned
note: different wanted poster: Captain J. Garvey vs Baron Longshore

ja: Ashenvaleは新しい開拓地なんだって。それで、BarrensにあるMor'shan塁壁はAshenvaleへの入り口だって。手つかずの自然を切り開く開拓者になれたら、すごくかっこいいだろうなあ! HordeとAllianceが将来ぶつかりあうところだって、みんなが言ってた。そこへ行ってみたいよ、{name}!
en: They say that Ashenvale is the new frontier, and that the Mor'shan Rampart in the Barrens is the gateway to it.  That would be so cool to be a pioneer, carving everything you need out of the untamed wilds!  They say that this is where the Horde and Alliance will clash the most in the future, and I want to be there $N!$B$BWould you take me to the Mor'shan Rampart so I can see what the frontier looks like, please?  I wanna see where the Horde is driving out those smelly night elves!
en_objectives: Take your ward to the Mor'shan Rampart in the northern part of the Barrens, just before entering Ashenvale.
label: aligned

ja: 最後のmoonwellを訪れてもらいたい。この場所から真っ直ぐ南へ行ったArlithrienの泉(the Pools of Arlithrien)の岸辺にある。泉を探す時には気をつけるのだぞ。手から武器を放すな。Teldrassil南部の大枝からくる穢れが増しているのを感じる。  水を手に入れたら、泉のところにいる見覚えのある者に渡してやってくれ。彼女は穢れと戦うことを望んでいてな、君に来てもらいたいそうだ。
en: There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.$b$bBe wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
en_objectives: Fill the Tourmaline Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
label: aligned
note: same moonwell quest, directions phrased differently

ja: Scholomanceへの鍵は骸骨の鍵と呼ばれている。鍵は実際に骸骨の残骸から作られているに違いない。そして、適合する鋳型に流し込まれた最も強固な金属によってのみ硬化するのだ。Scholomanceへの入り口を自然に開くことのできる者から得られる力の印章こそが、最終的にその鍵を機能させるだろう。
en: The key to Scholomance is called a Skeleton Key.  It must be forged from the remains of a skeleton - several actually - and hardened by only the strongest of metals within a suitable mold.  A signet of power from a being who naturally can open the portal to Scholomance will make the key ultimately function.$B$BFirst thing's first though, $N.  We'll need skeletal fragments for the key's forging.  Skeletons inside Andorhal should yield what we need, but the ones outside the walls might work too.
en_objectives: Bring 15 Skeletal Fragments to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
label: aligned

ja: ああ、あんた見ただけで分かるわ。幸運の御守りを作ってほしがってるね。Mau'ariにはお見通しだよ!
en: Ah, I can tell just by lookin' at ya -- you be wantin' to make a lucky charm. Mau'ari always knows!$B$BYou'll need ta travel to a place called Winterspring ta the north, far from da heat of Durotar.$B$BIn Winterspring, to da south. you'll find a canyon, an' giants made a' solid ice. The giants sometimes be carryin' dem, but ya can always gather da shards yerself from da canyon. These shards have a powerful reflective quality.$B$BBring back 10 frostmaul shards, and my lucky charm will be yours.
en_objectives: Collect 10 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: ベンチャー企業に雇われたこのノームの問題は、Undermineにちょっとした混乱をもたらしました。trade princesはRzazdunkがこのGerenzoと付き合うことを承認していません。
en: The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.$b$bRiddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.$b$bWhatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
en_objectives: Bring the new orders to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
label: aligned

ja: Shadowfang攻めに向けて、2人のdeathstalkerを情報収集に向かわせた。もう何日も経ったのに2人とも戻ってきていない。しかし、攻撃を成功させるには2人の報告を受けねばならんのだ!
en: In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!$B$BSo here is your task, $N.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.$B$BThis mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N.  Do not fail.
en_objectives: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
label: aligned

ja: これがKravelの荷包みだよ、{name}。それから、これを届けた時に伝えておいてくれ……もっと特別な注文がしたかったら、ツケを払えってな!
en: Here's Kravel's package, $N.  And when you deliver it, tell him... if he wants more special orders, then he'll have to pay his tab!
en_objectives: Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
label: aligned

ja: Nazzに関する情報を得るのは大変だよ、{name}。ああ、かなりね。だがお前さんはその情報を得るため、はるばる煌めく塩原(the Shimmering Flats)からやって来た……別のところへ行く気はあるかい?
en: Getting the information on Nazz is quite a favor, $N.  Yes, quite a favor.  But you've come all the way from the Shimmering Flats to get it... are you willing to travel some more?$B$BWhile I contact my sources, why don't you gather something for me, eh?$B$BHm... what will it be?  How about dream dust, from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.  Yes, I'd love some dream dust for my snuff pouch!$B$BGet it for me, $N, and I'll give you the information you seek.
en_objectives: Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay.  Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.
label: aligned

ja: MoongladeにいるKeeper Remulosの宮宰Rabine Saturnaは、TanarisとUn'Goroの遙か西にある広大な荒れ地を探検するのに援助を求めている。彼はMoongladeの大集落Nighthavenにいる。
en: For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris and Un'Goro.  He is located in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.$B$BI want to impart on you the importance of your presence.  There are growing tensions between the night elves of Darnassus and the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.  Look beyond racial boundaries and tap into the wisdom of your ancestors in dealings with the Circle there, $N.  Good luck.
en_objectives: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.  Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
label: aligned

ja: 南西に悲劇の地、Southwind村の廃墟がある。まず始めに着手せねばならん場所だ、{name}。
en: To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village.  This is where our work should begin, $N.$B$BFrom what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus.  It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes.  I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...$B$BThe tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly.  Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.
en_objectives: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
label: aligned

ja: 共にいる時間もおおむね終わりだ。俺は物知りではあるが、知恵の試しを課すのは俺じゃない。学ぶべき課題と訪れるべき場所がある。そこには知恵は自分の分野だと主張する別の者がいるんだよ。
en: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.$B$BIf you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $N.$B$BWhen you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $N, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
en_objectives: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
label: aligned

ja: あばずれ! 豚! Kenataがまだ生きている。あいつの家族が健康で栄えている間、私は苦しむ。まさしく見捨てられたのよ!
en: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!$B$BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.$B$BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!$B$BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
en_objectives: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.
label: aligned

ja: レース車の設計に使う新しい燃料調整装置を完成させるので忙しいんだ。オレたちのチームをもっと手伝ってくれるっていうのなら、Razzericと話してくれ。彼はパイロット……えっと、厳密には18人目のね……で、彼は自分で車に少し手を加えるのが好きなんだよ。
en: I'm going to be busy with working on integrating this new fuel regulator to our racer designs, but if you'd like to help out the team some more, talk to Razzeric. He's our pilot--well, our eighteenth pilot, to be exact--and he likes to add his own little modifications to the racers.$b$bHe's a little off his rocker, though, so try not to act too surprised.
en_objectives: Speak with Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
label: aligned

ja: うちの新しいレシピに殻のしっかりした大きなカニの脚が必要なんだよ。Dustwallowにいるカニ……spiny rock crawlerって呼ばれてるカニがばっちりなんだ!  この殻は料理の肝で、傷ついてないキレイなヤツが欲しいんだ。よく育ったカニなら一本や二本は採れるんじゃないかな。料理の研究のためにもたくさん欲しいんだ。  Theramoreの周りの岩場へ行って、カニの脚を持ってきてくれ!
en: Another component of my new recipe is the shelled leg of a giant crab.  And the crabs they have in Dustwallow -- Muckshells they call them -- just won't do!  I'm afraid the only suitable crabs live far away, in the Swamp of Sorrows.$B$BThe shell of the crab leg is a key element of the dish's presentation so I need pristine, unscarred legs.  An adult crab might only have one or two such legs, and I need a lot in order to research my dish.$B$BSo, $N... are you willing to travel?
en_objectives: Bring 12 Pristine Crawler Legs to Morgan Stern in Theramore.
label: misaligned
note: factual mismatch: spiny rock crawler 'perfect' vs Muckshells 'won't do'

ja: Atal'Hakkar神殿で起きた奇妙な出来事を調査するよう、Warchiefが我々を送り出したんだ。
en: The Warchief sent us to investigate strange happenings at The Temple of Atal'Hakkar.$b$bThe Atal'ai trolls are a tribe of dark casters, known for practicing forbidden magic. You can imagine how astonished we were when we arrived here to discover the temple had been sunk.$b$bThe green dragons now guard the site, claiming to be protectors of Azeroth.$b$bWe need to discover what happened. Explore around the Pool of Tears and gather Atal'ai artifacts. From those I can begin to piece together this puzzle.
en_objectives: Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.
label: aligned

ja: 悪魔の蔓延は他の影響無しに起こらない……邪悪な者が足がかりを得るのを、何かが許しているのだ。  それは弱き精神、力を求める不必要な欲望から起こるのに違いない。恐らくそれは復讐の渇きか、最後の審判を求める望みだ。我々が痛みに苦しんでいるとき、邪悪な者が優位に立つ……サテュロスのような邪悪がな。  奴らとBurning Bladeの間にはすでに結びつきが出来ているのだ。それでThrallは奴らを討伐させるのだろう。ここの北西に行って奴らを探し、追い返したら戻ってきてくれ。
en: A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.$B$BIt may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.$B$BTies have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
en_objectives: Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
label: aligned

ja: ラプソディの奴は本当に酒が好きだった。いや誤解するなよ……ここにいるドワーフはみんな、酒を飲んでいい時に美味いビールをたしなんでるぞ。
en: Rhapsody took quite a liking to the booze. Now don't get me wrong -- all of us dwarves up here at the aviary love a good ale when the time is right.$b$bBut ol' Shindigger took to the liquor like a gryphon takes to the skies. And a damned shame it was, too. No one could fly like Rhapsody.$b$bFirst sign of trouble was when he came stumbling back from that mission with your buddy, Brohann. All went down hill quickly after that. Had to let him go.$b$bLast I heard, he's set up a brew camp to the east of here...
en_objectives: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.
label: aligned

ja: 火のトーテムを扱えるだけの力があるようだが、それで準備が整っているとはいえない。
en: You are powerful enough to wield the totem of fire, but that does not mean you are ready.$B$BAlong the Southfury River in Durotar, before the Great Sea, lies a hidden trail to one of the highest peaks in the land. Find your way to the top and you shall find one of our holy shrines watched over by Telf Joolam--the Shrine of the Dormant Flame.$B$BTake this torch to him--it marks that you attempt to tame fire. Return it to me aflame by the brazier at the shrine and I will see you are given the totem of fire.
en_objectives: Bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
label: aligned

ja: 君が最後に試されてからだいぶ経つな、{name}。これまでの修練で君は忍耐強さを示してきたが、さらに学ぶべき時が来た。水の清らかさについて学ぶ時が来たのだ。
en: Long has it been since you were last tested, $N. You have shown patience thus far in your studies, but the time has come for you to learn more. The time has come for you to learn about the purity of water.$B$BSeek out Islen Waterseer in the Barrens. She is along the eastern coast, south of the Southfury River and Ratchet. You will find her there at her fishing hut. Good luck to you, $N.
en_objectives: Find Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.
label: aligned

ja: 理解を見出し、私からsaptaを授かるには、水の最も自然な姿を追求するのよ。サンプルを取ってくる時は、あなたの周りにある物をよく見ることね。生き物たちが水を頼りにし、水を守っていることに気が付くのよ。森と砂漠にどう水が影響を与えているか見て。命を繋ぐ水という物質自体が、いかに生き物たちに命を奪わせているか目の当たりにするのよ。
en: To find understanding and gain the sapta from me, you must seek out only the purest forms of water. As you fetch the samples for me, take note of your surroundings. Be aware of the creatures that rely on the water, that protect it. See how it affects forests and deserts. Witness how the very substance that sustains life will force creatures to take lives.$B$BWe shall start with a simple task: down below my hut there is a pond of the precious liquid. Fill this skin with it and return to me.
en_objectives: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the watering hole below Brine's hut and return it to her in the Barrens.
label: aligned

ja: 昔、仲間たちの後についてHillsbrad Foothillsへ行ったことがあるわ。あそこを拠点にしてるしつこい人間たちから身を守って、Forsakenが支配している小さな町、Tarren Millへ着いたの。
en: Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.$B$BIt was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.$B$BBring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
en_objectives: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.
label: aligned

ja: Darnassusにいる私たち、とりわけ職人は本当に忙しいのです。若い冒険者たちが荒野で己を試したがり、常に物資を必要としています。  革製品の注文をさばくのを手伝ってくれたら、もっと進んだ皮加工技術を教えてあげられるかもしれません。
en: We in Darnassus, especially we craftsman, are quite busy.  Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.$B$BIf you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.
en_objectives: Bring 1 Embossed Leather Glove, 5 Embossed Leather Boots and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to Lotherias in Darnassus.
label: aligned

ja: メモの写しを作ったぞ。お前さんの鎧を作っている間に身に着けた技を書き留めたものだ。鍛冶屋のMathielに送ってやらないといかんな。Mathielは遙か遠いDarnassusに住んでいるけども、俺が学んだものを身につけるのをとても喜ぶはずだ。
en: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and need them sent to the blacksmith Mathiel.  He lives in Darnassus which is quite a long way off, but I'm sure he'll be very grateful to learn what I've learned.
en_objectives: Bring Furen's Notes to Mathiel.
label: aligned

ja: felhunterの召喚を学ぶ時がきた、{name}。ここでは君を教えるのに必要な触媒や品物を持っていないんだ。だから、別の者を捜さなきゃならないんだよ。我々の仲間、Strahad Farsanをね。
en: It is time you learned the felhunter summoning, $n. I do not have the reagents and items necessary to teach you here, so you will have to seek out another, Strahad Farsan, another of our inner circle.$b$bHe makes his residence in the goblin port of Ratchet. I will send word ahead of you to inform him of your coming.
en_objectives: Speak with Strahad Farsan in the Barrens.
label: aligned

ja: 炉へ行って仕事に取り掛かっちゃどうだろう? 君の到着に備えてたから、ほとんど時間はかからないはずだよ。
en: Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.$B$BWhen we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.$B$BI'll be somewhat honest, $N, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.
en_objectives: Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you.
label: aligned

ja: 声を落とせ、 {name}。ああ、名前は分かってる。お前の説明に基づいて、あるオークを見張るように言われたからな。
en: Lower your voice, $n. Yeah, I know your name. Was told to keep an eye out for an orc by your description.$b$bFrom what we've heard about you, you can handle yourself in combat, and aren't opposed to a little sneakery from time to time.$b$bAm I right?$b$bAnyways, you should go see Therzok in Orgrimmar. He's got an offer for you to hear.
en_objectives: Speak with Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: {name}? 確かなことじゃないのだけれど、Carkadはあなたに興味を抱いていると思うの。人は見かけによらない、でしょ?
en: $n? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?$b$bEither way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.
en_objectives: Speak with Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
label: aligned

ja: 伝説の都市XavianはAshenvale東部の奥深くに抱かれている。その古の知識に関する話は、教養のある者たちにはよく知られた話。Xavianの水には莫大な魔力があると言われているわ。
en: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern Ashenvale, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned.  It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.$B$BI would have a sample of those waters, from their source.$B$BTake this flask and go to Xavian.  Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me.  And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.
en_objectives: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: 仕事のお礼に、新しいローブの作製を手配してあげたわ。あなたが必要な素材を集めてこられるなら、ね……。
en: For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...$B$BFor these robes, you must return to Ashenvale for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.$B$BWhen you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the Barrens.  He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.
en_objectives: Bring 12 Laughing Sister's Hairs to Kil'hala at the Crossroads.
label: aligned

ja: 恐らく……おそらく君ならGnomereganの戦いに協力できる。
en: Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan.$B$BIn Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators.$B$BYou will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind.$B$BGood luck, $N.
en_objectives: Speak with Shoni the Shilent in Stormwind.
label: aligned

ja: Droffers and Son Salvageは首飾りの魔力を修復できるほど賢くなかろう。だが俺ならできる。俺の望みは、首飾りの研究をすることだけだ。首飾りを自分で作れるようにするためにな。それにはその首飾りが必要なんだ。貸してくれ。研究させてくれたお礼に日記を翻訳してやろう。あんたが宝石を探している間に、研究に必要な時間がとれるはずだ。
en: Droffers and Son Salvage aren't smart enough to restore the magic in the necklace, but I am.  All I want to do is study the necklace so I can learn to make them myself.  To do that, I will need your necklace.  Let me borrow it, and in exchange for the time I get to study it I will translate the journal for you.  While you are searching for the gems, I should have enough time to learn what I need to.$B$BIt's a simple deal, and no one else will be the wiser.  Whatcha wanna do?
en_objectives: Let Jarkal borrow the necklace.  In exchange, he will translate the journal for you.
label: aligned

ja: ホウキでコウモリの檻を掃くなんてGarrett家の者にはふさわしくない! この憎たらしい仕事で小金を稼いで、俺の身分をより良くするためにあんたにつぎ込むつもりだ。
en: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett!  I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.$B$BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers.  Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.$B$BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me!  Help me restore my birthright!
en_objectives: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
label: aligned

ja: エメラルドが……無い! ドリームキャッチャーが壊されている!  Starbreeze の北に Gnarlpine 族 mystic の集団がいます。その族長、夢食いの Ferocitas が夜間緑色に輝くネックレスを着けていたそうです。私のドリームキャッチャーの状況からして、きっと Ferocitas がエメラルドを盗んだのでしょう……あの力が自分の役に立つと分かっているはずでしょうから。  無くなった宝石を見つけて下さい、{name} 。それから、ついでに堕落した mystic も一掃して欲しいのです。
en: The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!$B$BThere is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.$B$BFind this missing jewel, $N. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
en_objectives: Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar wants you to kill 7 Gnarlpine Mystics and find the Missing Jewel.
label: aligned

ja: {name}、20代にわたってOmosh家はこのハンマーを握ってきたんだ。10万トンもの金属を我々は鋳造してきた。悲しいけれど、それもOmosh家の不作、Orokkで終わる。血縁も無く、子孫を作る能力も無いせいでな。  Omosh家に伝わってきた秘密の製造法を自分と一緒に死なせることはできん! この遺産を誰かが受け継いでいかねばならんのだ。Omoshであろうがなかろうが関係なく!  有能であることを証明してくれ、{name}。これから言う物をOrokkに持ってきてほしい。patterned bronze bracers・bronze greatsword・sharp clawをそれぞれ2つずつ。それをOrokkのところへ持ってきてくれたら、続けよう。
en: Twenty generations of Omosh have held this hammer, $N. A hundred thousand tons of metal we have molded. Tragically, it all ends at Orokk, failure of the Omosh: Without kin and incapable of producing offspring.$B$BI cannot let the secret recipes of Omosh die with me! Someone must continue the legacy, Omosh or not!$B$BProve to Orokk you are capable, $N. Bring for Orokk the following: Two patterned bronze bracers, two bronze greatswords, and two sharp claws. Bring them for Orokk and we shall continue.
en_objectives: Bring two Patterned Bronze Bracers, two Bronze Greatswords, and two Sharp Claws to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: 去年の全国鍛冶選手権で、観客全員、俺の作った脚鎧がVenture社鋳造所の卑怯な犬に裏をかかれたのを目撃したんだ。でも、俺が試合を続けて結局トーナメントに勝てたみんなの知らない理由がある。その通り、装飾ミスリルブーツさ!
en: At last year's All-Valley Blacksmithing Championship, all those who watched saw my leg get swept from under me by a cowardly dog from the Venture Co. Foundry. What they didn't know, however, was the reason I was able to continue and ultimately win the tournament: That's right, ornate mithril boots!$B$BI will need to learn how to craft ornate mithril pants for this year's tournament, however, as a Venture Co. shredder is an entrant! Teach me the way of the pants and learn the way of the boot!
en_objectives: Bring two Heavy Mithril Boots and one Ornate Mithril Pants to Trenton Lighthammer.
label: aligned

ja: ノームの新しい乗り物（Rig）のことをKernobeeから聞いて、すぐにScootyと私はGnomereganへの最も速くて信頼性が高い交通手段、Transpolyporter 6000にとりかかりました。
en: As soon as we got word from Kernobee about the new gnomish rig, Scooty and I began work on the Transpolyporter 6000: The fastest and most reliable way to Gnomeregan.$B$BIt's finally ready for passengers to board, $N. If you want to give it a try, go to Booty Bay and talk with Scooty at the wind rider roost. To get to Booty Bay, take the boat from Ratchet.$B$BOf course, you could always try and make the run to Gnomeregan through the dwarf infested mountains of Dun Morogh!
en_objectives: Speak with Scooty in Booty Bay.
label: aligned

ja: もっと複雑なレッスンをこなす準備ができたな、{name}。Wild Leatherレギンスは一番作りが頑丈で強力な皮装備の一部だ。腰・太もも・ふくらはぎ・そして急所……すべての箇所へ非常に素晴らしい防御をもたらしてくれる。野ツタ(the wildvine)による強化とあいまって、Wild Leatherレギンスを手に入れた冒険者は君を見るたび感謝することだろう。
en: You are ready to master more complex lessons, $n.  Wild Leather leggings are some of the sturdiest and powerful leather gear around.  The waist, thighs, calves, and the vitals - all are given tremendous protection.  Coupled with the enhancement that the wildvine provides, adventurers who own it will thank you each time they see you.$B$BFor you to gain this pattern, I need two Turtle Scale helms, two Turtle Scale bracers, and two wildvines.
en_objectives: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
label: aligned

ja: 君は私が昔から禿げていたと思ってないのだろう? その通り! この悲惨な脱毛を引き起こしたのは、Gnomereganの放射能漏れなのだよ。あの日以前の私は、Azeroth中でも随一の奇抜な髪型「gnomefro」をしていたんだ。
en: You don't think I was always bald, do you? No $g sir:ma'am;! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth.$B$B<Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.>$B$BDamn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!!$B$BPerhaps it's not too late, $N. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
en_objectives: Speak with Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos.
label: aligned

ja: わしらがGnomereganから逃れた時、たくさんのデータを置いてきてしまったんだ! 決定的に重要なデータを!
en: When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind!  Vitally important data!$B$BI need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan.  You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... and to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C.  And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... and we left all the punch cards in the city.$B$BIt's a catastrophe!  Can you help?
en_objectives: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
label: aligned

ja: Witherbark族の蜘蛛神から集めてきた毒は大発見だ! 24羽近いウサギをたったひと垂らしで殺すことができたんだ。確かにウサギはまだ小さくて、人の手のひらに収まるほど小さいから毒に対する抵抗も弱いと思う。だが、この毒が強力だってことは否定できん!
en: The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find!  I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff.  Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful!$B$BI'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the Undercity.  I am positive he would want to test this himself.
en_objectives: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
label: aligned

ja: Sharpbeakは檻の中に捕まっている。奥地(the Hinterlands)のJintha'Alorの一番上にある崖の上だ。檻の鍵はVilebranch族トロルの最高司祭が持っている。堕落司祭Hexx(Vile Priestess Hexx)だ。
en: Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.  The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx.$B$BThere.  I have done my part.  I bid you fortune on your quest, $N.
en_objectives: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
label: aligned

ja: ついさっき、メッセンジャーがお前を捜していたぞ、{name}。彼女は確か、ハンタートレイナーのLankaに寄越されたんだと思う。この手紙がLankaからのものなら、俺だったら読むのに時間をかけないね。
en: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the hunter trainer Lanka. If this note is from Lanka, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
en_objectives: Read the Etched Note and speak to Lanka Farshot in Red Cloud Mesa.
label: aligned

ja: ついさっき、メッセンジャーがお前を捜していたぞ、{name}。シャーマントレーナーのMeelaに寄越されたんだと思う。この手紙がMeelaからのものなら、俺だったら読むのに時間をかけないね。
en: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $N. I believe she was sent by the shaman trainer Meela. If this note is from Meela, I wouldn't take long in reading it's contents.
en_objectives: Read the Rune-Inscribed Note and speak to Meela Dawnstrider in Camp Narache.
label: aligned

ja: {name}、君がコボルドのキャンプから戻ったらすぐこれを渡すように頼まれたのだ。ウォーリアトレイナーLlaneの印章で封がされているようだな。私なら、この僧院の別の仕事に取り組む前にぐずぐずせず読むよ。
en: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Llane, our local warrior trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
en_objectives: Read the Simple Letter and speak to Llane Beshere in Northshire Abbey.
label: aligned

ja: 私は、コボルドキャンプ地からお前が戻ったらすぐにこの封書を届けるよう、頼まれていたのだ。この封書は、教官であるJorikの徽章で封をされている。これをお前が他の任務でここに来る前に、読んでほしかったのだ。
en: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Jorik, one of our local trainers. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
en_objectives: Read the Encrypted Letter and speak to Jorik Kerridan in the stable behind Northshire Abbey.
label: aligned

ja: 君が Blackrock族のスパイを始末して戻ってきたらすぐこれを渡すよう頼まれたのだ。メイジトレイナー Khelden の印で封がされているようだな。私なら修道院の別の仕事に取り掛かる前にすぐ読むね。
en: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
en_objectives: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside Northshire Abbey.
label: aligned
note: same trainer letter; JA says Blackrock spies where EN says kobold camps

ja: これは検証となるだろう。私が行った儀式とお前の能力両方のな。この器を持って行け、{name}。これを使うと、生き物を小さくして中に閉じ込める力を得るだろう。
en: This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, $N. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.$B$BTravel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, $N. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
en_objectives: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.$B$BBring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
label: aligned

ja: お前に依頼する最後の仕事は、北西へ行き最後の敵を探すことだ。
en: The last task I will require of you is to travel to the northwest and find the final enemy.$B$BThe mountain giants left the mountains to aid the night elves when the burning legion appeared in the world. You will know them by their massive size and the way the ground begins to shake as you travel along their rocky terrain.$B$BI am eager to harness power of that size. Kill 7 mountain giants, then use the muisek vessel to capture their powerful muisek.
en_objectives: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.
label: aligned

ja: Mithril Orderのためによく尽くしてくれたね、{name}。これを手に入れるために必要だった真の献身は、並みの者なら逃げ出すだろうよ。君が我々の一員だということに、俺にもGalvanにも疑問はない。
en: You have done much for the Order, $N. The sheer dedication it takes to get this far would have turned away any ordinary person. There is no doubt in my mind, or in the mind of Galvan, that you are one of us.$B$BWhich is why I think you deserve a little reward. It is nothing really, just a trinket. You may be familiar with its properties, as I do believe it is what brought you to us in the first place.
en_objectives: Wait for Trenton to finish his work.
label: aligned

ja: OrgrimmarのBelgromのところへ戻ってくれ。彼も自分の目でこいつを見たいだろう! 我々もすぐ戻る。
en: Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself! We'll return there shortly.$B$BAh, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, $N.
en_objectives: Speak to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: Mosh'aruのいにしえの預言では、Hakkar神の魂を手に入れる方法が言及されている。それはふたつの石板に書かれていてな、Gadgetzanの西、トロルの都Zul'Farrakに運ばれておる。
en: The ancient prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of a way to contain the god Hakkar's essence.  It was written on two tablets and taken to the troll city of Zul'Farrak, west of Gadgetzan.$B$BBring me the Mosh'aru tablets!$B$BThe first tablet is held by the long-dead troll Theka the Martyr.  It is said his persecutors were cursed into scarabs and now scuttle about his shrine.$B$BThe second tablet is held by the hydromancer Velratha, near the sacred pool of Gahz'rilla.$B$BWhen you have the tablets, bring them to me.
en_objectives: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
label: aligned

ja: Hakkarの化身の魂を捕らえる時がきた。
en: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar.$B$BTake the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth.  Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god.$B$BHe will send his minions against you.  Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit.  When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world.$B$BDefeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
en_objectives: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.
label: aligned

ja: 我々は、Evergreen Pouchと呼んでいるもので、Un'Goro Craterの土にあるTharlendris seedを栽培してきた。その種は何かの薬草に成長する。そのうちのひとつがmorrowgrainといって、我々にもほとんど知識のない神秘的な草だ。Cenarion Circleのために、是非ともこの神秘を解き明かしたい。
en: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater.  These seeds have blossomed into an array of random, potent herbs.  One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I very much hope to unravel this mystery for the Circle.$B$BTake this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us.  If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.
en_objectives: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
label: aligned

ja: 可哀想なGargal……あれが来るのを見ることさえなかった。ドン! 矢が頭の天辺、ど真ん中に突き刺さったんだ。彼には才能はなかったけれど、今は……。
en: Poor Gargal... didn't even see it coming. WHAM! The arrow landed dead center on the top of his head. He was no genius before but now...$B$B<Galamav grimaces.>$B$BWhen we dislodged the arrow, we noticed a rolled up note attached to the shaft. On the note was a crudely drawn picture of an orc behind bars with the signature of Commander Gor'shak attached.$B$BIf he's still alive in the Depths, you'll have to find him.$B$BA trap you say? Well no kidding, numb hooves! That's why you're going!
en_objectives: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths.$B$BYou recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.
label: aligned

ja: Dragonflightを探している? お前の力を見せてみろ、定命の。
en: You seek out the Flight? Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
en_objectives: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth.$B$BYou have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.
label: aligned

ja: 悪党Hurley Blackbreathに率いられたDark Iron族のドワーフが、Thunderbrew家最高のレシピThunderbrew Lagerを盗んだんだ。悪党どもめ! あんな上質のビールはあいつらにゃ相応しくないわい!
en: The Dark Iron dwarves, led by the villain Hurley Blackbreath, stole one of the Thunderbrew's best recipes, Thunderbrew Lager.  The villains!  They don't deserve such a fine brew!$B$B$N, I have a tough task for you.  Go to the Blackrock Depths in the Burning Steppes, destroy any kegs of Thunderbrew Lager you find, and bring back our recipe for Thunderbrew Lager!$B$BPlease, get that recipe back, even if you have to turn Blackrock Depths upside down to do it!
en_objectives: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
label: aligned

ja: ふーん、「ひび割れし手」(The Shattered Hand)を手伝える仕事あるよ。おいらが考えてる仕事。うん、Jes'rimon確かにあんたの助けを生かせるよ。
en: Hmm, maybe there be somethin' you can do for the Hand now that me think 'bout it. Yes, Jes'rimon could use your help for sure.$B$BIn Un'Goro Crater there be raptors with deadly claws. Some of those raptors sometimes have white claws instead of ones black like death. The Hand have... clients... that like weapons crafted from these claws. Bring me many of those white claws, and me pay you good coin. Do it fast enough, and maybe me help you in other ways.
en_objectives: Bring 8 White Ravasaur Claws to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned

ja: 頼む、批判する前に最後まで聞いてくれ!
en: Please, hear me out before passing judgement!
en_objectives: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.
label: aligned

ja: Magni王にこの情報を知らせてほしい、{name}。王は何をすべきかお分かりになられるはずだ!
en: You must take this information back to King Magni, $N. He will know what to do!
en_objectives: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.
label: aligned

ja: おまえもついにその時が来たようだな。{name}... Hordeの名のもとに戦う年に。そう、Warchiefの栄誉を得る為に。
en: Finally, you are of age, $N... of age to battle in the name of the Horde. To conquer for the glory of the Warchief.$B$BYes...$B$B<Kaltunk looks you over.>$B$BYou will do nicely.$B$BNo doubt you wish to find a great dragon or demon and strangle it with your bare hands, but perhaps it would be wise to start on something less... dangerous.$B$B<Kaltunk laughs.>$B$BReport to Gornek, he should be able to assign a task better suited to a young $c. You will find Gornek in the Den, to the west.
en_objectives: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.
label: aligned

ja: 次の課題は最初と同じくらい簡単。でも、手伝いを捜す必要があるわ。
en: Your next task is as simple as your first, but will require you to seek out aid.$B$BI require gold thread for the embroidery of the cloak, but gold thread is not easy to come by, and very few know how to make it. Fortunately, one who is loyal to our cause knows its secrets and is willing to help those rising in our ranks.$B$BBring a gold bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Booty Bay. He is a master tailor and will be happy to spin the thread for you. Gold bars are smelted by skilled miners. Ask a miner for help.
en_objectives: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.
en_title: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
label: aligned

ja: Tinkeeに必要な物はほとんど持ってるけど大事な素材をひとつ無くしちゃってね、それがchillwindの角なんだよ。Winterspringにいるchillwindキメラの角は冷気の凝縮源なんだが、無傷で欠けてない角でなきゃだめなんだ! Tinkeeの注文をこなすにはそれを調達しなきゃならんよ。
en: I have most of what Tinkee needs, but I'm missing one important component, and that's chillwind horns.  The horns of the chillwind chimaera in Winterspring are a concentrated source of cold, but only pristine, uncracked horns will do!  I'll need a supply of those to complete Tinkee's order.$B$BBring me the uncracked chillwind horns, and I'll prepare a package for Tinkee.
en_objectives: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.
label: aligned

ja: たった今殺されたwildkinの首から落ちたネックレスの重要性に、いまひとつ確信がもてなかった。ネックレスは輝かしい光を放ち、ちらちらとゆっくり瞬いている。
en: You are unsure of the significance of the necklace that fell from the neck of the recently-slain wildkin. It glows brightly, slowly fading in and out.$B$BTrull Failbane might be able to tell you more, since his knowledge of the wildkin seems extensive. Perhaps you should ask him about it.
en_objectives: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.
label: aligned

ja: quillboarの部族がこっちの方へ逃げてくるなんて、Southern Barrensで一体何が起きたんだろう。追放されたRazormane族は特にやけくそになってて、攻撃がひどくなってる。今週だけでもうキャラバンをふたつも失ってるよ!  Crossroadsの戦士はあの物資を本当に必要としてるから、quillboarどもを悪事で肥えさせるつもりはまったくない。無くなった物資の箱を見つけて持ってきてほしいんだ。川に沿って、南の方にあるquillboarのむさ苦しい洞窟を探してもらうよ。
en: That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.$B$BYou've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.$B$BThe people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
en_objectives: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.
label: aligned
note: same caravan/Razormane quest, longer JA
