ja: 駆け出しのドルイドが水生動物の姿を身につける前に教わるべき修行は、すべて終わった。さあ、DarnassusのMathrengyl Bearwalkerのところへ戻りなさい。彼にそのペンダントを見せ、教わるべきものを習得する準備ができていると示すのだ。習得が済めば、水と一体となることができよう。
en: You have completed the necessary lessons all young druids are taught before they can adopt an aquatic aspect.  Go now back to your trainer, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, in Darnassus.  Show him your pendant and prove to him you are ready to learn what he has to teach you.  He will complete your training, allowing you to become one with the water.$B$BGoodbye, young druid.  We shall speak again.
en_objectives: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
label: aligned

ja: この緑の液体……Felwoodを通った時に見た泥を思い出すわね。それに、Winterfall Runnerが何頭かTimbermaw族のところへ入っていくのを見たこともある……このことと、あなたが見つけた小瓶とは何か関係があるかもしれない、{name}。
en: This greenish liquid... it reminds me a bit of the sludge I saw when traveling through Felwood. And I have seen some Winterfall Runners passing into Timbermaw... Perhaps these things have something to do with the flask you found, $N.$B$BThere is a large group of furbolg just past Timbermaw Hold, in Felwood. Called the Deadwood tribe, they have been corrupted and driven mad by the fel. Why don't you look around there and see if you can find any evidence of dealings between the Winterfall and the Deadwood?
en_objectives: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
label: aligned

ja: 倒した蛇の死体から、何やら重要な手紙らしきものを見つけた。手紙はWyrmthalakの上官、Drakkisath将軍からの命令だと思われる。
en: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol.$B$BYour instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
en_objectives: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.
label: aligned

ja: 国の英雄よ、聞くがいい。Hordeは迅速な行動を求めている!
en: Heroes of the realm, hear me - the Horde calls upon you for swift action!$B$BA call to arms has been issued for all able bodied individuals to take up arms against the Scourge!  Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Eastern Kingdoms.  They loom to the east of the Undercity, in the northern reaches of the lands now known as the Plaguelands!$B$BHeroes of the realm - seek out High Executor Derrington, who has set up his base camp at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades!
en_objectives: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.
en_title: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
label: aligned

ja: 優れた正義の手段を、Halehは選ぶことができなかった。無理難題のカタログ(the catalogue of the wayward)を読んで悟るのだ。
en: A finer instrument of justice, Haleh could not have chosen. Read from the catalogue of the wayward and be enlightened.$B$BShould you persist... should you do what is asked of you... should you survive... a hero you will make.
en_objectives: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.
label: aligned

ja: {name}、Shadowglenでの仕事が終わったならDolanaarへ行かねばなりません。向こうにLaurna Morninglightがいるはずです。彼女はEluneの道へとより深く導いてくれます。Eluneの司祭としての身分を示す法衣を彼女からもらえるでしょう。
en: $N, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a $gpriest:priestess; of Elune.$B$BTake care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
en_objectives: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
label: aligned

ja: Orgrimmarの街の下に、トログという名で知られている頑丈な生き物がいる。溶岩に満ちる洞窟の奥深くから、その生き物が外界へ出てこようとしているのだ。常に慈悲深いお心により、Magatha様はその生き物と和解しようと考えていらっしゃるのだが、トログどもはMagatha様の使者に敵意を示し、殺してしまったのだ。トーレンに対するそのような扱いをMagatha様はお許しにならぬ。そして今、あの生き物はHordeすべての脅威であるとお考えなのだ。
en: Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.$B$BShe asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
en_objectives: Search Orgrimmar for Ragefire Chasm, then kill 8 Ragefire Troggs and 8 Ragefire Shaman before returning to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
label: aligned

ja: 軍用船舶の世界へようこそ!    Warcraft CollectorのEditionのWorldを購入することの特別な感謝として、Goldshireでこのギフト券をMerissa Stilwellに渡してください。 次に、贈り物をあなたに与えるでしょう: 冒険と栄光を求めるあなたの探索のときにあなたに加わる小さい仲間。    重ねてありがとうございます、WarcraftのWorldで滞在を楽しんでください!
en: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Merissa Stilwell in Northshire Valley.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
en_objectives: Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.
label: misaligned
note: machine-translated gibberish of the CE voucher text

ja: Utherが殺された時、Order of the Silver Handは徹底的に潰された。
en: The Order of the Silver Hand was utterly decimated when Uther was slain.$B$BThe boy held out for as long as he could. Pushed to the war torn hamlet of Northdale, he made his final stand.$B$BWere any of the Order left alive, he thought - and did it matter?$B$BIt was with that thought that Taelan threw down the standard of the Order and renounced all that he had known. His honor left upon the blood soaked ground of Northdale.$B$BYou must travel to Northdale and recover that symbol of lost honor.
en_objectives: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
label: aligned

ja: ようこそWorld of Warcraftの世界へ！
en: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!$B$BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.  You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.$B$BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
en_objectives: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
label: aligned
note: JA is only the first sentence, same quest

ja: ちょうど最近、Tanarisに放浪オーガの一団がやって来たの。ここの南で、奴らは砂漠の大部分を支配下において混成団を結成したわ。いくつかの小規模な集団がいつも砂漠をうろついていて、その中のいくつかがトロルの古代遺跡を占領してしまった。
en: Just recently, a large bank of nomadic ogres arrived in Tanaris. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins.$B$BThe Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force.$B$BThe leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.
en_objectives: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.
label: aligned

ja: ホードは常に兵士の英気を養い・・・the Great War以来、ここKalimdor で繁栄してきた。
en: The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.$B$BI need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
en_objectives: Maggran wishes you to deliver a letter to Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift in the Barrens.
label: aligned

ja: 長い間、私はGrand Crusaderの操り人形だった。Scarlet Crusadeとなって戦うのに、どんな理由があったかだと? それは何十年経っても、我が父の思い出だ。あの大切な思い出が、私を生かしてくれた。
en: For so long, I have been a puppet of the Grand Crusader. What reason was there to fight against what the Scarlet Crusade had become? It has been decades, yet the memories of my father; those precious memories, they are what have kept me alive.$B$BI have dreams, stranger. In these dreams my father is with me. He stands proudly at my side as I am inducted into the Order. We battle legion of Scourge, side by side. We bring honor to the Alliance, to Lordaeron.$B$BI want not to dream anymore.$B$BTake me to him.
en_objectives: Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
label: aligned

ja: Auberdineのすぐ東に、moonkinの洞窟がたくさんあります。Auberdineに最も近い洞窟の中に、Moonkin Stoneがあります。Moonkin Stoneの守護者であるLunaclawは、Cenarion Lunardustが石に使われたとき姿を現すでしょう。「爪」のひとつとして使わねばならない力を、Lunaclawは身に宿しています。
en: Directly east of Auberdine lay many moonkin caves.  The one closest to Auberdine has a Moonkin Stone inside it.  Lunaclaw, the defender of the stone, will face you only when Cenarion Moondust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.$B$BYou've earned the right to use this Cenarion Moondust, $N... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
en_objectives: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw.  From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.$B$BSpeak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
label: aligned

ja: こんにちは、若い狩人さん。動物をうまく操って、相棒として訓練するだけの力がありそうね。
en: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.$B$BYou must see Thotar at Razor Hill. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
en_objectives: Speak with Thotar at Razor Hill.
label: aligned

ja: 君に要求する最後の課題は、空中の住人を飼い慣らすことだ。swoopは厄介な敵だが、味方としては脅威的な存在となって鋭い攻撃をもたらすはずだ。
en: The final task that I have for you requires that you tame a creature that inhabits the sky. The swoop is a difficult opponent, but as your ally, you will acquire its sharp attacks and threatening presence.$B$BBy the will of the Earthmother, when you return I will bestow you with the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing to be your companion; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as you wish.
en_objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Swoop. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
label: aligned

ja: Brillへの補給品はこの箱の中に入れておいた。Brillのバットマスターと話をしてあるなら、ここからコウモリに乗って戻れるよ。  Undercityのバットマスター、Michael Garrettと話をしな。Brillに戻るこうもりを用意してくれるよ。
en: I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.$B$BSpeak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
en_objectives: Bring Gordon's Crate to Michael Garrett.
label: misaligned
note: different quest: Brill/Undercity Michael Garrett vs Sepulcher supplies

ja: Brillのコウモリ使いはAnetteだ。もうあの人に会っているのなら、コウモリで送り返してやれるぞ。  コウモリはいつでもUndercityへ飛べるが、もっと遠くの場所へ飛んでいくには、乗り手がまずその地域を訪れてコウモリ使いと話していなくちゃならないんだ。  あんたはBrillでAnetteと会ってるから、今すぐあそこへ飛べるだろう。準備ができたらもう一度俺に話しかけてくれ。
en: The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok.  If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.$B$BOur bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.$B$BYou have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
en_objectives: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon's Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.
label: misaligned
note: different quest: Brill bat master Anette vs Sepulcher Karos Razok

ja: 素敵! 月の神殿で勉強を続けるあいだ、故郷を偲ぶよすがにちょうど必要だったものです。今夜このレシピをひとつ作ってみることにします。待ち遠しい!  お礼の手紙を Nyoma に届けていただけませんか? Dolanaar へお戻りになるのならヒポグリフを借りるといいですよ。出立の準備ができたらヒポグリフマスター Leora を訪ねて下さいな。Dolanaar へ戻るのを手伝ってくれますよ。
en: From Rut'theran, there are two methods of travel to Auberdine: by ferry and by hippogryph.  Both are quick and reliable, but if you have not yet flown to Auberdine by hippogryph, then I suggest you do.$B$BIt is sound advice to speak with the hippogryph master in every town that has one.  Once you speak to the master, you can then fly there from other towns.$B$BHere is Nessa's collection.  Speak with me again when you are ready to fly to Auberdine and deliver Nessa's collection to Laird.
en_objectives: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa's Collection to Laird.
label: misaligned
note: different quest: Nyoma/Dolanaar recipe vs Rut'theran travel

ja: 安い運賃でThunder Bluffまで乗せてやろう。Thunder Bluffまで行くのに、これより速い方法はないぞ!  もしそうしたいなら、準備ができてからまた俺に話しかけてくれ。  皮の束をAhanuのところへ持って行くんなら、彼はThunder Bluffのウインドライダータワーのふもとにある、「Hewa's Armory」にいたと思う。ウインドライダータワーってのは、ちょうど着陸したところだ!
en: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff.  There's no faster way to the city!$B$BIf that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.$B$BIf you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff.  And that's right where you'll land!
en_objectives: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.
label: aligned

ja: VargがBloodhoof Villageで売る革製品を準備しておいた。Vargのところへ持って行ってくれないか?  もうBloodhoof Villageでウインドライダー使いと話をしてあるなら、Thunder Bluffのウインドライダーで飛んでいけるよ。  この革製品をThunder Bluffのwind rider使いTalに持って行って、Bloodhoof Villageへ運んでもらう手配をするといい。
en: I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads.  Will you bring them to him?$B$BIf you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.$B$BTake the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.
en_objectives: Bring Ahanu's Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.
label: misaligned
note: NPC/place differ: Varg at Bloodhoof Village vs Jahan at Crossroads

ja: 友達に渡したい選りすぐりの肉があるんだ。友達の名前はGryshka。Orgrimmarの宿の主人なんだ。肉を届けてくれないか?  Orgrimmarへ一番早く着く方法はウインドライダーに乗ることさ。Razor HillのウインドライダーBurokのところへ肉を持って行って、Orgrimmarまで乗せてくれるよう話してくれ。
en: I have some choice cuts of meat that I want to send to a friend.  Her name is Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar.  Will you deliver the meat for me?$B$BThe fastest way to Orgrimmar is on a wind rider.  Take the meats to the Crossroads wind rider master, Devrak, and speak with him about transport to Orgrimmar.
en_objectives: Bring Zargh's Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.
label: aligned

ja: {class}、あなたが見てきたようにこの地は苦しんでいるけれども、生命の循環というのは力強いものなのですよ。今私たちはこの地を助けるため、共に役目を果たさねばなりません。この種を破壊の中心地、西の焦げ谷(the Charred Vale)へ植えてきてください。気をつけるのですよ、ハーピーや怒れる炎の精霊があの傷ついた土地をいまだ苦しめていますから。
en: As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.$B$B$N, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
en_objectives: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.
label: aligned

ja: たった数枚のコインでOrgrimmarまでウインドライダーで送ってやるぞ。着いたら、Grimtakの肉をGryshkaのところへ持って行ける。彼女はValley of Strengthの宿にいる。  旅の準備ができたらまた話しかけてくれ。
en: For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar.  When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka.  Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.$B$BSpeak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
en_objectives: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh's Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.
label: misaligned
note: NPC differs: Grimtak's meat vs Zargh's Meats

ja: あなたは大地に対する隠された脅威を暴きました、{class}。洞窟で見つけたResonite cask には、Goggrerocという名の眠れるEarthenが含まれています。
en: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, $c. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.$B$BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.$B$BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, $N!
en_objectives: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
label: aligned

ja: 幻と変装。それこそがBlack Dragonflightを欺き、求める物を得る方法だ。
en: What do you know of illusions, $N? For you see, it is an illusion that you must create in order to circumvent the Black Flight's defenses.$B$BI know of one that may be willing to assist you in your quest of deception. She has assisted our kind in the past when she has deemed the cause worthy.$B$BIn the Western Plaguelands you will find Myranda the Hag, master illusionist - an exile of the Lordaeron alliance. Travel there and take with you this message.
en_objectives: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
label: aligned

ja: 時の監視者、Nozdormuの子供たち……世紀の王……。
en: The time watchers, children of Nozdormu - Lord of the Centuriesss...$B$BIt is three that guard the Caverns of Time, but only one that holds the interests of the Black Flight: The Time Shifter, Chronalis, favored drakeling of Nozdormu.$B$BSsstrike at this champion, a blow to make even the stoic sands of time weep. Return to me with his skull.
en_objectives: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.
label: aligned

ja: 結束した竜たちの力に対する我らが父の激しい怒りは、Grim Batolの山々をも凌ぐものだった。裏切り者Alexstraszaの卑怯な行いは、父の怒りから他の竜たちが逃げおおせる時間を稼ぐには充分だった。
en: It was over the mountains of Grim Batol that our Father raged against the combined might of the Aspects. The cowardly act of the betrayer, Alexstrasza, bought the other Aspects enough time to escape from Father's wrath.$B$BSssuch a shameful act...$B$BThe Red Flight now guards Grim Batol, their lieutenant, Axtroz, must be destroyed. Return the skull of Axtroz to me. For Father, whelp!
en_objectives: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.
label: aligned

ja: 何か教えてくれるとでも思ったかい? あたしの料理の魔法を全部手に入れたってのに、まだこれ以上欲しいってのかい!  あたしじゃご希望に添えないね。太っちょ{race}はGadgetzanへ行きな。あそこにDirgeって名前のちびゴブリンがいる……あいつなら叶えてくれるよ、おでぶさん。  有名な料理人になったら、戻ってきてあたしに教えとくれ。いいかい? じゃあ行きな!
en: How you expect Zamja teach you anything? You got all of Zamja's cooking mojo and still you crave more!$B$BZamja can't help. Fat $r needs to go to Gadgetzan. You find a little goblin named Dirge there - he help you, fatty.$B$BWhen you become big cook on the block, you come back and teach Zamja, ok? Now go!
en_objectives: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
label: aligned

ja: 料理スプーンを見れば、あんたが料理の何を理解してるか分かるぜ。残念ながら、俺に教えられることは何もない。  あんたにゃラッキーなんだが、俺はある男を知ってる。そいつはゴブリンで、恐らくKalimdorで最高の料理人だ。  おっと、こいつは悪い知らせだが……Kalimdorへ行かなきゃなんねえぞ。Gadgetzanへ行ってDirge Quikcleaveを探しな。あいつなら解決してくれるだろ。
en: I can tell by yer cooking spoon that ye know what yer doin'. Unfortunately, I can't teach ya nothin'.$B$BLuckily fer ye, I know a guy. He's a goblin and probably the best cook on Kalimdor.$B$BAyep, that's the bad news, $g lad:missy; - ye got to travel to Kalimdor. Git to Gadgetzan and find Dirge Quikcleave. He'll set ya straight.
en_objectives: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.
label: aligned

ja: 友よ、素晴らしいWinter Veilを! 必ずGreatfather Winterに挨拶して下さいね! 今年あなたが親切だったなら、Winter Veil祝祭日の素晴らしいご馳走を受け取れるでしょう。今年欲しい物を彼に伝えるのもお忘れ無く!  あと、今年親切にしてくれた人にあげるご馳走を買い込むのもお忘れ無きよう。選ぶ物は豊富に取り揃えていますよ。私たちの農場から、あなたのお皿まで新鮮なものを……それがSmokywood Pasturesの健康に良い美味しさ!
en: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend!  Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Orgrimmar!  If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil.  Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!$B$BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year.  We have a great selection to choose from.  Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
en_objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
label: aligned
note: JA omits 'currently in Orgrimmar', same quest

ja: 杖はかつて希望の源だった。この洞窟に溢れんばかりの力を与えてくれたのだ。私は、伯父の魂に平穏をもたらすことを願っていた……
en: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.$B$BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.$B$BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!
en_objectives: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.$B$BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.
label: aligned

ja: Alterac Valleyの墓地は重要な拠点だ。Horde、Alliance双方ともに、この神聖な場所のために獰猛に戦う。{name}よ、戦う準備はできたかね?  君に、墓地の敵を急襲して欲しい。中央にHordeの軍旗が掲げてある墓地を探し、地面に軍旗を引きずり下ろせ! それをやれば、君の任務は完了だ....  しかし、もし君が墓地を数分間保持することもできれば、我らの兵がすぐに君の代わりに駆けつけるだろう。
en: The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories.  Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds.  Are you, $N, ready to join that fight?$B$BI want you to assault an enemy graveyard.  Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground!  Do that, and your task will be complete....$B$BBut if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.
en_objectives: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
label: aligned

ja: はるか北西にあるOracle Treeの下にあるmoonwellを訪ねてもらいたい。最初にmoonwellにして、最も力ある泉……その水は女神Eluneの力の本質そのものを秘めていると言われている。  その水を汲んで持ち帰ってきてくれ。それが終わったら、Darnassusの前にある三叉路で会おう。
en: All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.$b$bHowever, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
en_objectives: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
label: misaligned
note: different quest text (Oracle Tree moonwell vs Staghelm/Teldrassil)

ja: Feralasにいるトーレンの長老Talo Thornhoofが支援依頼を送ってきた。いくらか詳細が書かれているが、繊細さと……残忍さの両方を兼ね備えた要員を必要としているそうだ。
en: Talo Thornhoof, a Tauren elder in Feralas, sends a request for aid.  He offered few details, but he did say that he needs agents for a matter both delicate... and dire.$B$BServe the Horde, $N.  Go to Camp Mojache in Feralas and speak with Talo.
en_objectives: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.
label: aligned

ja: この責務を引き受けようと思うのならば、刃のこぼれた剣をLydrosに示して下さい。
en: If you wish to take on this task, present Lydros with the dull blade.
en_objectives: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.
label: aligned

ja: 署名者はこれにより、Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.)に届けられた Sulfuron インゴットが正規品であり複製でないことを証明する。また、署名者は Sulfuras を建築し、鋳造し、発見し、制作し、売却し、あるいは摂取を企図した結果として発生するいかなる損害も受け入れるものとし、これについては TB Ltd. の過失あるいは責任とはならない。  この契約に署名することにより、ここに記載された全条項に同意するものとする。  _  署名:
en: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to $g him:her; as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd.$B$BBy signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein.$B$B_________________$B$BSignature
en_objectives: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.
label: aligned

ja: 懐かしい気持ちが蘇ってきた。体全体に、歓迎すべき勝利の痛みが響き渡っている。目の前に横たわっているのは、歴戦を物語る巨大な Nefarian の傷だらけの首だ。これを Varian Wrynn 王のところへ持ち帰るのだ。
en: The old feeling returns. The welcome pangs of victory reverberate throughout your being. Before you lies the monolithic, battle scarred head of Nefarian. Return it to your Highlord, champion.
en_objectives: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.
label: aligned

ja: 知っていることはすべて話したぞ、{name} 。elementium を見つけるのはお前だ。火の王の化身を滅ぼすのはお前だ。  為し遂げて Thunderaan の祝福を得よ。
en: I have told you all that I know, $N. It is you who must find elementium. It is you who must destroy the Firelord's corporeal form.$B$BDo this and gain the blessing of Thunderaan.
en_objectives: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
label: aligned

ja: Thunderaan を倒した。眠りについた剣を手に取り、裏切りのために集めさせられた材料を使って Thunderfury を覚醒するよう、嘘つきの卑劣漢 Demitrian に強制しなくてはならない。
en: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury.
en_objectives: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.
label: aligned

ja: 門のカードを一組揃えると、最初の8枚が元通りになったのと同じように9番目のカードが神秘的に現れた。そのカードにはこう書いてあった。「これらのカードをDarkmoon Faireに返却せよ。さすれば、報われよう」  Darkmoon FaireはMulgoreとGoldshireへ2、3ヶ月おきに交互に立ち寄ると聞いたことがある。彼らが次にやってくるまで待たなくてはならない。
en: Now that you have gathered all of the Portal cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
en_objectives: Return the Portals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
label: aligned

ja: 精霊のカードを一組揃えると、最初の8枚が元通りになったのと同じように9番目のカードが神秘的に現れた。そのカードにはこう書いてあった。「これらのカードをDarkmoon Faireに返却せよ。さすれば、報われよう」  Darkmoon FaireはMulgoreとGoldshireへ2、3ヶ月おきに交互に立ち寄ると聞いたことがある。彼らが次にやってくるまで待たなくてはならない。
en: Now that you have gathered all of the Elemental cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
en_objectives: Return the Elementals Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
label: aligned

ja: 「廃坑に運命が待っている」
en: "Your fortune awaits you inside the Deadmines."$B$BThe fortune Sayge handed you feels slightly warm to the touch.  Grasping it firmly, you see an image of the Deadmines inside Westfall's ruined hamlet of Moonbrook.  Focusing closer in on the image, you wind about twisty passages until you reach a shimmering portal... one that leads into the heart of the mines itself.  Stepping through it, a strange chest appears out from nowhere.
en_objectives: Travel to the Deadmines in Westfall and seek out your fortune.
label: aligned

ja: Zandalarは神聖な支配者と語らう者に力を授けている。我らの司祭はただ回復を行うだけの者ではなく……聴罪を行う司祭でもあるのだ。邪悪は、Hakkarといった外部の脅威と部族内の双方からやって来る。聴罪司祭は審判者として行動し、Gurubashi帝国が内より貪られたのと同じ邪悪から我々を守っている。
en: We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity.  Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors.  Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe.  Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself.$B$BGo to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi.  Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.
en_objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
en_title: Paragons of Power: The Confessor's Wraps
label: aligned

ja: Zandalarの向こう見ずな者たちはローグと似ているな。だが、何にもまして彼らは狂気……混沌……神出鬼没さを受け入れている。戦場で目を開いたままでいるのは恐ろしいな。部族が分裂した後、荒廃した時代に、彼らは敵の中へ混沌と破壊の種を蒔いたのだ。我々は彼ら無くしてここにいることはなかったろう。
en: The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence.  A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered.  We would not be here today without them.$B$BBring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors.  Embrace the madness!
en_objectives: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
en_title: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
label: aligned

ja: courserは、すでに知られた土地では最も力強い角を持つ鹿です。その角は常にcourserを守り、攻撃者を突き刺して、時にその傷へ損傷を与えます。疵のない素の状態の角は、最高の自信を持つ動物の魂の象徴なのですよ。
en: The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands.  Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points.  Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.$b$bTo hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.$b$bHunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
en_objectives: Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
label: aligned

ja: 断片を解読して魔法を解くには少し時間がかかる。終わったら、私が個人的にRavenholdt卿へ袋を届けよう。
en: It will take some time to decipher the fragments and remove the enchantment.  When I am complete, I'll deliver the bag to Lord Ravenholdt personally.$b$bThere is still the matter of the key, said to be held by a green drake known as Morphaz.  The drake has made its home deep in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in the Swamp of Sorrows.$b$bGather your friends and venture to his lair.  Lord Ravenholdt will await your return with the key.
en_objectives: Return the Azure Key to Lord Jorach Ravenholdt.
label: aligned

ja: Atal'Hakkar神殿の奥深くにMorphazという名の緑竜がいる。
en: There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.$b$bYears ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole.  While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.$b$bYou must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple.  Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.
en_objectives: Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
label: aligned

ja: 時間を無駄にはできない! 英雄を見つけなければ! 私が与える仕事を完了するには大勢の仲間が必要となろう。しかし、Brood of Nozdormuの責任と重荷を背負い英雄として立ち上がることができるのは、群衆の中でたったひとり。
en: There is no time to waste! A hero must be found! The task I give will require an army to complete but only one may rise from the throng of would be champions to take on the burden and responsibility of an ally of the Brood.$B$BWithin the lair of the Lord of Blackrock is a most cruel beast. The Broodlord Lashlayer guards the Halls of Strife, blocking the way into Nefarian's inner sanctum. Slay the foul aberration and return his head to me. Do this and you may begin the next step of your journey.
en_objectives: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
label: aligned

ja: お菓子をねだりに行きたいんだけど、病気で行けないんだ。もし僕の代わりに行ってくれたら、もらったキャンディと交換してあげる! {name}はこのキャンディ好きだと思うよ……おかしかったり、怖かったり、いろいろ変わるから!大きな街にいる宿屋の人がそれぞれHallow's Endのキャンディをくれるんだ。話しかけて、頼まれた芸をしてね! それと、Sen'jin VillageにいるKali Remikって名前のトロルがよくキャンディを配ってるよ。キャンディを全部集めたら、僕のところへ持ち帰ってきてね!
en: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!$B$BEach of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a troll named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
en_objectives: Speak with the innkeepers of Orgrimmar, Undercity, and Thunder Bluff, as well as Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village.  Perform the tricks they ask of you in exchange for the treats they offer.$B$BReturn to Spoops at the Orgrimmar Orphanage with a Thunder Bluff Marzipan, Darkspear Gumdrop, Orgrimmar Nougat, and Undercity Mint.
label: aligned

ja: この彫像は、Qirajiが大きな竜の骨格のところで3匹のsilithidに遭遇したことを説明しています。彫像の上にあるものは、私には何らかの記号としか思えません。この記号が使者を呼び出す鍵である可能性は非常に高いです。
en: The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon. Above the glyphs is what I can only assume to be a code of some sort. This code might very well be the key to summoning the emissary.$B$BI will create a copy of the glyph code that you must use in the sand at the Bones of Grakkarond. If I am right, the Overlords will come thinking that new data is ready for transmission. Strike them down and confront the emissary. He holds the key to the crystals...
en_objectives: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary.$B$BYou have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed.$B$BAssemble an army for this task, $N!
label: aligned

ja: お菓子ねだりだな! 頑張れよ!ところで、あんたは病気の子のためにキャンディーを集めて何やら慈善活動のようなことをしているようだが、俺はそう甘く見てはやらんぞ。その子にあげる美味しいGnomeregan Gumdropがあるが……汽車の汽笛をやってみせてくれるならな! ははは、そう、おふざけだよ! このガムドロップの代金は汽笛一回さ!シュッポ、シュッポ、{class}!
en: A trick-or-treater!  Huzzah!$B$BWell now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily.  I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me!  Haha, yes, that'll be the trick!  The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!$B$BChugga-chugga, $c!
en_objectives: Do a train emote at Talvash del Kissel, and in exchange you'll receive a Gnomeregan Gumdrop!
label: aligned

ja: その……あなたが着ている衣装面白いですね。あなたは親切で、今年お菓子をねだる病気の子供の手助けをしていらっしゃいますけれど、あいにく私はあなたに芸をしてもらうつもりなんですよ!  見せてもらいましょうか……とても強くてマッチョに見えるその……衣装……腕の筋肉を曲げ伸ばししてみて下さい! ええ、今すぐ始めて下さい。お強い方!  やって下さった時にだけ、美味しいOrgrimmar Nougatを差し上げましょう。素晴らしいHallow's Endのご馳走ですよ。
en: That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!$B$BLet's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong $g man : woman;!$B$BWhen and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
en_objectives: Do a flex emote at Innkeeper Gryshka, and in exchange you'll receive Orgrimmar Nougat!
label: aligned

ja: {name}、Ashlam Valorfist司令官が君のような高潔さと武勇あるパラディンの召集を発令していたぞ。司令官はWestern Plaguelands南部にあるChillwind Campにいる。彼を探して、「光」に貢献してくれ!
en: Commander Ashlam Valorfist has sent out a call for a paladin of your purity and valor, $n.  You can find him at Chillwind Point in the southern part of the Western Plaguelands.  Seek him and aid in his cause for the Light!
en_objectives: Speak to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Point.
label: misaligned
note: place differs: Chillwind Camp vs Chillwind Point (Cataclysm rename)

ja: Ahn'Qirajの下で、口に出すのも恐ろしい古き神が微睡みからゆっくりと目覚めています。Azerothを待ち受けている恐ろしい運命は数日後か、あるいは何年後かにやって来るでしょう。あのような力を持つ存在にとって、時間に意味などありません。  星回りが揃えば、あの神は激しい怒りとともに生きとし生けるものへ襲い掛かるでしょう。そうなる前に発見し、あの存在に終わりをもたらす方法を見つけるのです。  そうしたら、あの神の殻の一部を持ってきて下さい。定命の者が身につけたことのない鎧を授けてあげましょう……神を討ち取ったことのある者にしか着られない鎧を!
en: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj.  The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power.$B$BWhen the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath.  You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end.$B$BDo this and bring me a piece of his husk.  I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
en_objectives: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of War, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj.  You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
label: aligned

ja: 私としたことが。私の最大の敵、ドクターWeavilの古い手だ! 今、Winterspringでの失敗に感謝している。ドクターWeavilは本を破いて壊したのだ! 英雄よ、世界を救いたいと思わんかね?
en: I should have known. My arch-enemy, Doctor Weavil, up to his old tricks! And now, thanks to your failure in Winterspring, Doctor Weavil has destroyed my book! How are you going to save the world now, hero?$B$BThe note I received stated that the only known copy of "Draconic for Dummies: Volume II" was ripped into 8 parts and scattered to the wind! If you somehow manage to find those missing chapters, use this magical binding to put them back together and return to me.
en_objectives: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
label: aligned

ja: Qirajiの魔法は強く、古くから伝わるもの。最も強いQirajiはそういった力を持つ品を振るい、竜にさえ躊躇させたのだ。  Qiraji支配者の留め具と他の小さな材料を持ってきてくれれば、強力なブーツを作ってあげよう。  敵との戦いにおいて役立つことが分かるだろう。
en: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.$B$BBring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.$B$BYou will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
en_objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
label: aligned

ja: Qirajiとその下僕たちは極めて貴重な最高の素材で作られた品を振るっている。巨大な古の生物の骨や、大地の奥深くから掘り出された宝石や、純粋で強い金属といったような。  まさにQirajiの秘宝の姿は、あれをばらばらに砕いて溶かして自分の作品を作り上げたいという衝動を湧き上がらせるよ。{name}、Cenarion Circleへの忠誠を示してくれれば、Qirajiの最高の素材を使って強力な武器を作ってあげるよ。
en: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.$B$BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces.  Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
en_objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2  Amber Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus.  You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
label: aligned

ja: Eranikusの動きを封じなくてはならぬ。彼を倒すことなく、罪から救い出すのだ。
en: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him.$B$BTyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction.$B$BBe on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.
en_objectives: Defend Nighthaven from Eranikus. Do not let Keeper Remulos perish. Do not slay Eranikus. Defend yourself. Await Tyrande.
label: aligned

ja: Twilight's Hammer狂信者の騎馬部隊がCenarion Hold軍の勢力外で馬を走らせ、我が軍の小規模な警備隊や補給部隊を狙い撃ちしていることが分かった。
en: Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans.$B$BFind and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna.  Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
en_objectives: Slay Twilight Marauder Morna and 5 Twilight Marauders.  Report to Windcaller Proudhorn when your task is finished.  You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
label: aligned

ja: 大事件が起きてしまいました! トナカイの Metzen が誘拐されてしまったのです!
en: DISASTER has struck!  Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!$B$BMetzen is one of Great-father Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures.  We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen.  With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here!  Please - find Metzen and return him to us!$B$BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!$B$BPlease, hurry!
en_objectives: Find Metzen the Reindeer.  Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.$B$BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.$B$BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Kaymard Copperpinch in Orgrimmar once Metzen is freed.
label: aligned

ja: 最近の有志の参加で、制服が足りなくなってきている。制服の材料を調達し、Windcaller Proudhornに渡すように。
en: The latest influx of volunteers has caused a shortage of uniforms.  Procure a batch of uniform materials and bring them to Windcaller Proudhorn.
en_objectives: Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
label: aligned

ja: 我らは千年の間手をこまねいていたわけではないのだ、{name}。  あの獣どもは己が役立たずになった時、自ら他の者の餌食となるのを見守っていた。奴らがこの世界を破壊する計画を企てているのを我らは聞いた。そして内なる裏切りを知ったのだ。  奴らには弱点が存在する。我らはそれを有利に用いる方法を知っている。  奴らが儀式に用いる武器を見つけ、持ってくるのだ。あの神の激昂から作られた元素と融合させれば、罰を与える力となるであろう。
en: We have not sat idly by for a millennium, $N.$B$BWe have watched these beasts feast on their own when they have exhausted their utility. We have listened as they have plotted and schemed to destroy our world. And we have learned of their own internal treachery.$B$BWeaknesses exist and we know how to use those weaknesses to our advantage.$B$BFind and bring me their ceremonial armaments: Combined with the element created from the volatility of their own God, they will become a force of reckoning.
en_objectives: Arygos in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring him Imperial Qiraji Armaments and 3 Elementium Ore.
label: aligned

ja: 月の祭の招待状を手に入れたのですから、Moongladeへ行けますよ! そこにはお祭り騒ぎの人たちがたくさんいますし、Nighthavenの里ではValadar Starsongと彼の姉妹Farielがお祝いに加わってくれることを願って待っています。  この大いなる月光を通ってMoongladeへ行き、Valadar Starsongと話して下さい。お祭りの間にどんな賞品がもらえるか、見てみて下さいね!
en: Now that you have your Lunar Festival invitation, you may travel to Moonglade!  There you will find many revelers, and in the village of Nighthaven Valadar Starsong and his sister Fariel await those eager to participate in the celebration.$B$BTravel to Moonglade through the greater moonlight and speak with Valadar Starsong; see what prizes you might gain during the festival!
en_objectives: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.
label: aligned

ja: ここの門で番をしなくちゃならないんだが、いつも恋人Colaraのことが心配で。彼女とは数時間しか会えないんだ。運が良くて上手くいけば、この通りさ。下士官の給料をもらって、いつでも前線に呼ばれる可能性もある。
en: I've got to keep watch here at the gate, but I'm always worrying about my sweetheart, Colara. I only get to see her for a few hours, if I'm lucky, and well, just look at me. I've got a minor officer's pay and I could be called to the front any day now.$b$bWould she just forget about me? There are a lot of men in the city. A lot of rich ones.$b$bAnyways, I've scribbled some things down... nothing much, but if you could take it to her for me, that'd be great.
en_objectives: Deliver Lieutenant Heldric's Carefully Penned Note to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
label: aligned

ja: もう随分前、子供の頃の恋人Eleniaと婚約したんだ。最後に彼女のことを考えてから数年になるが、最近、頻繁に頭が彼女のことでいっぱいなんだよ。
en: A lifetime ago, I was betrothed to marry Elenia, my childhood sweetheart. It's been years since I thought about her last, but of late, she frequently occupies my thoughts.$b$bPerhaps, even with everything that has passed, there can be some room in each other's lives for our love.$b$bI'm sure she has changed, also. Can you deliver this letter to her for me? I am too nervous to give it in person.
en_objectives: Deliver the Lovingly Composed Letter to Elenia Haydon near the bank in the Undercity.
label: aligned

ja: エンジニアリングの傑作だな、自分で言うのも何だがね! あいにく、君にはちょっと旅をしてもらわねばならん。我々の求める実体のないアンデッドを見つけるためにな。
en: A fine piece of engineering, if I do say so myself!  You will need to travel a bit, I'm afraid, in order to find the incorporeal undead we require.$B$BYou see, different climates lend different consistencies to the spectral fabric of the dead.  The tortured night elves of Silithus, the spirits of the highborne from Winterspring and the ghosts and banshees of the Eastern Plaguelands should give us the different types of ectoplasm we need.  Be sure to place the distiller nearby before you harvest them!
en_objectives: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
label: aligned

ja: あなたは約束を守って、Muxの作った装置を持ってきてくれた。難を逃れようと考えてあなたを雇うのなら、それに見合う報酬を渡すのが順当だと信じているわ。性能を上げたいベルトとグローブを持ってきてちょうだい。お返しに渡す物は、より優れた物になっていると約束するわ。
en: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux.  I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin.  Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.  I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
en_objectives: Bring a Dreadmist Belt and a set of Dreadmist Wraps to Deliana in Ironforge.
label: aligned

ja: 竜人王Valthalakの魂はこの護符に封じ込められた。自分たちを待つ呪いも知らず、我々は欲に駆られ、愚かにも護符を三つに分けてしまったのだ。
en: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet.  In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.$B$BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together.  Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces.  Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.$B$BI, for once, shall rest in peace.  I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
en_objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.

ja: 竜人王Valthalakを召喚するには、まず二番目三番目の護符を集める必要がある。そのためには、火鉢とその火をおこすのに特別な石炭を手に入れることが必要だ。
en: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it.$B$BThere are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and The Duke of Cynders in Silithus, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
en_objectives: Gather the Incendicite of Incendius, the Ember of Emberseer and the Cinder of Cynders, along with a Hallowed Brazier, and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
label: aligned

ja: 最近の行動の原因が掴めたと思う。水路の悪臭を越えてくる風に漂う、新しい香りをかいだことあるかい? 新しいコロンとパルファムが流行りだしているんだろう?
en: I believe I know the cause of this recent behavior. Have you smelled the new fragrance on the wind, over the stink of the canals? The new colognes and perfumes that have come into fashion?$b$bOur thinking has been clouded by some foul alchemy.$b$bThere is only one way to be sure - bring a bottle of cologne and perfume to my friend, Apothecary Zinge. The Royal Apothecary Society will find the truth.$b$b I will reimburse you for their purchase when you return.
en_objectives: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity's Apothecarium.

ja: 作るのを手伝ってもらったこの毒は、特別な事に使うんだ。巨大なdevilsaurのおかげで、クレーターで狩りをするのも生き残るのも難しくなってな。もしdevilsaurを殺すだけの力を持っていたとしても、devilsaurを殺せばまた別のdevilsaurがそいつの縄張りにやってくるだけで、切りがない。
en: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.$b$bTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
en_objectives: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
label: aligned

ja: 適した素材があれば、力を与える古代トロルの魔法を作れるのだ! Savage Guardのことを聞いたことがあるか? いや、無論聞いたことなどあるまい。お前の心は劣ったエルフ魔法でいかれているからな。
en: Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.$B$BBring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.
en_objectives: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Protection.
en_title: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Protection
label: aligned
